title.zh: 卷三百八十五 列傳第一百四十四 葛邲 錢端禮 魏杞 周葵 施師點 蕭燧 龔茂良
title.en: Volume 385 Biographies 144: Ge Bi, Qian Duanli, Wei Qi, Zhou Kui, Shi Shidian, Xiao Sui, Gong Maoliang
title.raw: 卷三百八十五 列傳第一百四十四 葛邲 錢端禮 魏杞 周葵 施師點 蕭燧 龔茂良 Volume 385 Biographies 144: Ge Bi, Qian Duanli, Wei Qi, Zhou Kui, Shi Shidian, Xiao Sui, Gong Maoliang

sentences.zh: 葛邲，字楚輔，其先居丹陽，後徙吳興。

translations.literal: Ge Bi, style name Chufu — his ancestors originally resided in Danyang, later moved to Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Bi, courtesy name Chufu, came from a family that had originally lived in Danyang before relocating to Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 世以儒學名家，高祖密至邲，五世登科第，大父勝仲至邲，三世掌詞命。

translations.literal: For generations they were a famous Confucian-learning house; from Founding Ancestor Mi to Bi, five generations passed the examinations; from grandfather Shengzhong to Bi, three generations held charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: For generations the family was renowned for Confucian scholarship: from Ge Mi the founding ancestor down to Ge Bi, five generations passed the civil examinations, and from Ge Shengzhong his grandfather down to Ge Bi, three generations served as imperial draftsmen.

sentences.zh: 邲少警敏，葉夢得、陳與義一見稱為國器。

translations.literal: Bi from youth was alert and keen; Ye Mengde and Chen Yuyi at first sight called him a vessel of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Bi was quick-witted from youth; Ye Mengde and Chen Yuyi both declared him a national treasure at first meeting.

sentences.zh: 以蔭授建康府上元丞。

translations.literal: By hereditary privilege he was appointed Assistant Magistrate of Shangyuan in Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By privilege of his family's office he was appointed assistant magistrate of Shangyuan in Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會金人犯江，上元當敵衝，調度百出，邲不擾而辦，留守張浚、王綸皆器重之。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens invaded the river region, Shangyuan lay in the enemy's path; requisitions came from every direction, yet Bi handled them without disturbance; the regional commanders Zhang Jun and Wang Lun both valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens crossed the Yangtze, Shangyuan stood directly in the enemy's path. Orders for supplies and levies poured in from every direction, yet Ge Bi fulfilled them without disrupting the district. The regional commanders Zhang Jun and Wang Lun both held him in high regard.

sentences.zh: 登進士第。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi civil examination.

sentences.zh: 蕭之敏為御史，薦其才，除國子博士。

translations.literal: When Xiao Zhimin was Censor, he recommended Bi's talent, and Bi was appointed Erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Zhimin served as censor, he recommended Ge Bi's ability, and Ge Bi was appointed erudite of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 輪對，論州縣受納及鬻爵之弊，孝宗獎諭曰：「觀所奏，知卿材。

translations.literal: In a rotating audience he discussed the abuses of local tax collection and the sale of offices; Emperor Xiaozong praised him, saying: "From what you have submitted, I know your talent.
translations.idiomatic: In an audience for policy discussion, he spoke on the abuses of local tax collection and the sale of offices. Emperor Xiaozong praised him, saying, "From what you have submitted, I know your ability.

sentences.zh: 」除著作郎兼學士院權直。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Drafting Officer concurrently Acting Attendant in the Academy of Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: " He was appointed drafting officer and acting attendant in the Academy of Scholars.

sentences.zh: 除正言，首疏言：「盈虛之理，隱于未然；

translations.literal: Appointed Remonstrating Censor, he first memorialized, saying: "The principle of fullness and emptiness is hidden before it happens;
translations.idiomatic: Appointed remonstrating censor, he first memorialized, saying, "The principle of plenty and want is concealed before it appears;

sentences.zh: 治亂之分，生於所忽。

translations.literal: the distinction between order and disorder arises from what is overlooked.
translations.idiomatic: the line between order and chaos is drawn from what is overlooked.

sentences.zh: 宜專以畏天愛民為先。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should make reverence for Heaven and love for the people the foremost concern.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should make reverence for Heaven and love for the people your foremost priorities."

sentences.zh: 」又論：「征榷歲增之害，如輦下都稅務，紹興間所趁茶鹽歲以一千三百萬緡為額，乾道六年後增至二千四百萬緡。

translations.literal: " He also argued: "The harm of annual increases in monopoly taxes — for example, the metropolitan tax office: during the Shaoxing era the annual tea and salt quota was set at 13 million cash; after the sixth year of the Qiandao era it rose to 24 million cash.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued, "The harm of yearly increases in monopoly taxes is plain. At the metropolitan tax office, for example, the annual tea and salt quota during the Shaoxing era was set at 13 million cash; after the sixth year of the Qiandao era it rose to 24 million.

sentences.zh: 成都府一務，初額四萬八千緡，今至四十餘萬緡，通四川酒額遂至五百餘萬緡，民力重困。

translations.literal: A single office in Chengdu Prefecture had an initial quota of 48,000 cash; it now reaches over 400,000 cash; the total wine quota for all Sichuan exceeds 5 million cash, and the people's strength is heavily burdened.
translations.idiomatic: A single tax office in Chengdu Prefecture had an initial quota of 48,000 cash; it now exceeds 400,000. The total wine quota for all of Sichuan has reached more than 5 million cash, and the people are severely overburdened.

sentences.zh: 至若租稅有定數，而暗耗日增，折帛益多，民安得不窮乎？

translations.literal: As for land tax, though the fixed amounts remain set, hidden losses grow daily and cloth levies in kind increase ever more — how can the people avoid destitution?
translations.idiomatic: As for land tax, though the fixed amounts remain unchanged, hidden losses mount daily and cloth levies in kind grow ever heavier. How can the people avoid destitution?

sentences.zh: 願明詔有司，茶鹽酒稅比原額已增至一倍者，毋更立新額，官吏不增賞，庶少蘇疲甿。

translations.literal: I beg that Your Majesty issue a clear edict to the responsible offices: where tea, salt, and wine taxes have already doubled the original quota, no new quota shall be set; officials shall receive no additional rewards — thus the weary farmers may recover somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: I pray Your Majesty issue a clear edict to the responsible offices: where tea, salt, and wine taxes have already doubled the original quota, no new quota shall be set and officials shall receive no additional rewards, so that the exhausted farmers may recover somewhat."

sentences.zh: 」上特召，復令條陳，邲以六事對，皆切中時病。

translations.literal: " The Emperor specially summoned him and ordered further memorials; Bi responded on six matters, all striking at current ills.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor specially summoned him and ordered further memorials. Ge Bi responded on six matters, all striking directly at the ills of the day.

sentences.zh: 除侍御史，論救荒三事，累遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was appointed Attending Censor, memorialized on three matters for famine relief, and was promoted repeatedly to Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed attending censor, memorialized on three measures for famine relief, and was promoted in succession to vice director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 歲旱，詔求初政得失，邲應詔，大略謂：「虞允文制國用，南庫之積日以厚，戶部之入日以削，故近年以來，常有不足之憂。

translations.literal: In a year of drought, an edict sought review of early policies' gains and losses; Bi responded, broadly stating: "When Yu Yunwen managed state finances, the reserves of the Southern Treasury grew daily while the Ministry of Revenue's receipts shrank daily; hence in recent years there has been constant anxiety over insufficiency.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of drought, an edict sought review of the gains and losses of early policies. Ge Bi responded, broadly stating, "When Yu Yunwen managed state finances, the reserves of the Southern Treasury grew daily while the Ministry of Revenue's receipts shrank daily; in recent years there has therefore been constant anxiety over shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 罷兵以來，諸將皆以賂得升，其勢必至於掊刻取償，益精其選。

translations.literal: Since demobilization, all generals have won promotion through bribes; this must inevitably lead them to squeeze and recoup; selection should be more rigorous.
translations.idiomatic: Since demobilization, generals have won promotion through bribes; this must inevitably drive them to squeeze the people to recoup their costs. Selection should be made more rigorous."

sentences.zh: 」遷給事中。

translations.literal: " He was promoted to Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 張嶷以說之子除知閣，裴良琮以顯仁之侄女夫落階官，邲皆繳奏。

translations.literal: When Zhang Yi was appointed Court Attendant on account of being the son of a favorite, and Pei Liangqiong was stripped of rank as husband of a niece of Empress Xianren, Bi returned both appointments for re-examination.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Yi was appointed court attendant because he was the son of a favorite, and Pei Liangqiong was stripped of rank as husband of a niece of Empress Xianren, Ge Bi returned both appointments for re-examination.

sentences.zh: 廣西議更鹽法，邲言：「鈔法之行，漕臣嘗紿群商，沒入其貲。

translations.literal: When Guangxi debated changing the salt law, Bi said: "When the salt-certificate system was introduced, the transport commissioner once deceived the merchant guilds and confiscated their property.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangxi debated changing the salt law, Ge Bi said, "When the salt-certificate system was introduced, the transport commissioner once deceived the merchant guilds and confiscated their property.

sentences.zh: 楮幣行之二廣，民必疑慮，且有後悔。

translations.literal: If paper currency is introduced in the two Guang regions, the people will certainly be wary, and regret will follow.
translations.idiomatic: If paper currency is introduced in the two Guang regions, the people will certainly be wary, and regret will follow."

sentences.zh: 」除刑部尚書。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 邲為東宮僚屬八年，孝宗書「安遇」字以賜，又出《梅花詩》命邲屬和，眷遇甚渥。

translations.literal: Bi served eight years as an aide in the Eastern Palace; Emperor Xiaozong wrote the characters "peaceful in encounter" as a gift, and also presented a poem on plum blossoms for Bi to compose a matching verse — his favor was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Bi served eight years as an aide in the Eastern Palace. Emperor Xiaozong wrote the characters "peaceful in encounter" as a gift and also presented a poem on plum blossoms for Ge Bi to compose a matching verse. The imperial favor shown him was very great.

sentences.zh: 光宗受禪，除參知政事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangzong received the abdication, Bi was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangzong received the abdication, Ge Bi was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 邲勸上專法孝宗，正風俗，節財用，振士氣，執中道，恤民力，選將帥，收人才，擇監司，明法令，手疏歷言之，上嘉納。

translations.literal: Bi urged the Emperor to take Emperor Xiaozong alone as his model, rectify custom, economize expenditures, revive the morale of scholars, hold to the middle way, spare the people's strength, select generals, gather talent, choose fiscal intendants, and clarify laws — he set these out at length in a hand memorial, and the Emperor approved with praise.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Bi urged the Emperor to take Emperor Xiaozong alone as his model: rectify custom, economize expenditures, revive scholarly morale, hold to the middle way, spare the people's strength, select generals, gather talent, choose fiscal intendants, and clarify laws. He set these out at length in a handwritten memorial, and the Emperor approved with praise.

sentences.zh: 除知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年，拜左丞相，專守祖宗法度，薦進人物，博采公論，惟恐其不聞之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxi he was appointed Left Grand Councilor; he strictly maintained the laws and institutions of the ancestors, recommended persons of merit, and gathered public opinion broadly, fearing only that he might not hear of worthy candidates.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxi he was appointed left grand councilor. He strictly maintained the laws and institutions of the ancestors, recommended worthy persons, and gathered public opinion broadly, fearing only that he might not hear of them.

sentences.zh: 未期年，除觀文殿大學士、知建康府。

translations.literal: Before a full year had passed, he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Prefect of Jiankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before a full year had passed, he was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改隆興，請祠。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Longxing and requested a sinecure post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Longxing and requested a sinecure post.

sentences.zh: 改判福州，道行感疾，除少保，致仕。

translations.literal: Transferred to serve as Administrative Commissioner of Fuzhou, he fell ill en route, was appointed Junior Guardian, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to serve as administrative commissioner of Fuzhou, he fell ill en route, was appointed junior guardian, and retired.

sentences.zh: 薨，年六十六。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 贈少師，諡「文定」，配饗光宗廟庭。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Preceptor, given the posthumous title "Wending," and granted a place in Emperor Guangzong's temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded grand preceptor, given the posthumous title "Wending," and granted a place in Emperor Guangzong's temple sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 有文集二百卷、《詞業》五十卷。

translations.literal: He left collected writings in two hundred juan and Compositions for the Examinations in fifty juan.
translations.idiomatic: He left collected writings in two hundred juan and Compositions for the Examinations in fifty juan.

sentences.zh: 錢端禮

translations.literal: Qian Duanli
translations.idiomatic: Qian Duanli

sentences.zh: 錢端禮，字處和，臨安府臨安人。

translations.literal: Qian Duanli, style name Chuhe, was a native of Lin'an in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Duanli, courtesy name Chuhe, was a native of Lin'an in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父忱，瀘川軍節度使。

translations.literal: His father Chen was Military Commissioner of the Luzhou Army.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chen was military commissioner of the Luzhou Army.

sentences.zh: 端禮以恩補官。

translations.literal: Duanli entered office by hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli entered office by hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 紹興間，通判明州，加直秘閣，累遷右文殿修撰，仕外服有聲。

translations.literal: During the Shaoxing era he served as Vice Prefect of Mingzhou, was promoted to Direct Access to the Secret Archive, and rose through posts including Compiler in the Hall of Literary Glory; his performance in provincial posts won reputation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing era he served as vice prefect of Mingzhou, was promoted to direct access to the Secret Archive, and rose through posts including compiler in the Hall of Literary Glory. His performance in provincial service won him a strong reputation.

sentences.zh: 高宗材之，知臨安府。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong noted his ability and appointed him Prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong noted his ability and appointed him prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞汪澈論版曹闕官，當遴選，權戶部侍郎兼樞密都承旨。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief Wang Che memorialized that the Ministry of Revenue lacked officials and that careful selection was needed; Duanli was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue concurrently as Chief Aide to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief Wang Che memorialized that the Ministry of Revenue lacked officials and that careful selection was needed. Duanli was appointed vice minister of revenue concurrently as chief aide to the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 端禮嘗建明用楮為幣，於是專委經畫，分為六務，出納皆有法，幾月易錢數百萬。

translations.literal: Duanli had once proposed using paper notes as currency; he was therefore entrusted exclusively with planning the system, which was divided into six branches with regulated receipts and disbursements; within months several million cash in coin was exchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli had once proposed using paper notes as currency. He was therefore entrusted exclusively with planning the system, which was divided into six branches with regulated receipts and disbursements. Within months several million cash in coin was exchanged.

sentences.zh: 孝宗銳意恢復，詔張浚出師。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong was keen to recover lost territory and ordered Zhang Jun to take the field.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong was keen to recover lost territory and ordered Zhang Jun to take the field.

sentences.zh: 會符離稍失利，湯思退遂倡和議，端禮奏：「有用兵之名，無用兵之實，賈怨生事，無益于國。

translations.literal: When the setback at Fuli became known, Tang Situi began advocating peace; Duanli memorialized: "There is the name of waging war but not the reality; it breeds resentment and creates trouble, benefiting the state not at all.
translations.idiomatic: When the setback at Fuli became known, Tang Situi began advocating peace. Duanli memorialized, "There is the name of waging war but not the reality. It breeds resentment and creates trouble, benefiting the state not at all.

sentences.zh: 」思退大喜，奏除戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: " Situi was greatly pleased and memorialized for Duanli's appointment as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Situi was greatly pleased and memorialized for Duanli's appointment as vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 未幾，兼吏部。

translations.literal: Before long he also held the Ministry of Personnel concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he also held the Ministry of Personnel concurrently.

sentences.zh: 端禮與戶部尚書韓仲通同對，論經費，奏：「所入有限，兵食日增，更有調發，不易支吾。

translations.literal: Duanli and Vice Minister of Revenue Han Zhongtong jointly addressed the throne on finances, memorializing: "Revenue is limited while military grain grows daily; if further levies are sent out, the treasury cannot long sustain them.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli and Minister of Revenue Han Zhongtong jointly addressed the throne on finances, memorializing, "Revenue is limited while military provisions grow daily. If further levies are dispatched, the treasury cannot long sustain them.

sentences.zh: 」上云：「須恢復中原，財賦自足。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Once we recover the Central Plains, revenues will suffice of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Once we recover the Central Plains, revenues will suffice of themselves.

sentences.zh: 」仲通奏：「恢復未可必，且經度目前所用。

translations.literal: " Zhongtong memorialized: "Recovery cannot yet be taken as certain; plan first for current needs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongtong memorialized, "Recovery cannot yet be taken as certain. Plan first for current needs.

sentences.zh: 」端禮奏：「仲通言是，乞採納。」

translations.literal: " Duanli memorialized: "Zhongtong's words are right; I beg they be adopted."
translations.idiomatic: Duanli memorialized, "Zhongtong's words are right. I beg they be adopted."

sentences.zh: 思退與張浚議和戰不決，浚方主戰，上意甚向之。

translations.literal: Situi and Zhang Jun could not settle the debate over war and peace; Jun still favored war, and the Emperor's mind leaned strongly toward him.
translations.idiomatic: Situi and Zhang Jun could not settle the debate over war and peace. Jun still favored war, and the Emperor's mind leaned strongly toward him.

sentences.zh: 思退詭求去，端禮請對乞留，又奏：「兵者兇器，願以符離之潰為戒，早決國是，為社稷至計。

translations.literal: Situi feigned a request to leave office; Duanli sought audience begging he be retained, and also memorialized: "Arms are instruments of violence; I pray Your Majesty take the rout at Fuli as a warning, decide the national policy early, and make this the paramount plan for the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Situi feigned a request to leave office. Duanli sought audience begging that he be retained and also memorialized, "Arms are instruments of violence. I pray Your Majesty take the rout at Fuli as a warning, decide the national policy early, and make this the paramount plan for the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 」於是思退復留，命浚行邊，還戍兵，罷招納。

translations.literal: " Situi was then kept in office; Zhang Jun was ordered to inspect the frontier, garrison troops were withdrawn, and recruitment levies were halted.
translations.idiomatic: Situi was then kept in office. Zhang Jun was ordered to inspect the frontier, garrison troops were withdrawn, and recruitment levies were halted.

sentences.zh: 以端禮充淮東宣諭使，王之望使淮西，端禮入奏：「兩淮名曰備守，守未必備；

translations.literal: Duanli was appointed Commissioner to Pacify and Instruct Huaidong; Wang Zhiwang was sent to Huaidong; Duanli entered to memorialize: "The two Huai districts are said to be prepared for defense, yet defense is not necessarily in place;
translations.idiomatic: Duanli was appointed commissioner to pacify and instruct Huaidong, and Wang Zhiwang was sent to Huaidong. Duanli entered to memorialize, "The two Huai districts are said to be prepared for defense, yet defense is not necessarily in place;

sentences.zh: 名曰治兵，兵未必精。

translations.literal: they are said to be training troops, yet the troops are not necessarily well drilled.
translations.idiomatic: they are said to be training troops, yet the troops are not necessarily well drilled.

sentences.zh: 有用兵不勝，僥倖行險，輕躁出師，大喪師徒者，必勝之說果如此，皆誤國明甚。

translations.literal: There are those who wage war without victory, take reckless risks in hope of luck, rashly take the field, and lose armies wholesale — if the doctrine that one must win truly were so, all of this grievously misleads the state.
translations.idiomatic: There are those who wage war without victory, take reckless risks in hope of luck, rashly take the field, and lose armies wholesale. If the doctrine that one must win truly were so, all of this grievously misleads the state.

sentences.zh: 」端禮既以是詆浚，右正言尹穡亦劾浚，罷都督，自此議論歸一矣。

translations.literal: " Duanli having thus attacked Jun, Remonstrating Censor Yin Ji also impeached Jun; the Grand Commander was dismissed, and from then on debate converged on one view.
translations.idiomatic: Having thus attacked Jun, Duanli was joined by remonstrating censor Yin Ji, who also impeached Jun. The grand commander was dismissed, and from then on debate converged on one view.

sentences.zh: 端禮至淮還，極言守備疏略，恐召金兵，宜早定和議。

translations.literal: When Duanli returned from the Huai region, he spoke urgently of lax defense and feared this would provoke the Jurchens; peace should be settled soon.
translations.idiomatic: When Duanli returned from the Huai region, he spoke urgently of lax defenses and feared this would provoke the Jurchens. Peace should be settled soon.

sentences.zh: 遂除吏部侍郎，再往淮上，驛疏言：「遣使、發兵當並行，使以盡其禮，兵以防其變，不必待金書至而後遣使。

translations.literal: He was then appointed Vice Minister of Personnel and sent again to the Huai frontier; by courier memorial he said: "Sending envoys and deploying troops should proceed together — envoys to fulfill all ritual propriety, troops to guard against sudden change; there is no need to wait until the Jurchen letter arrives before sending envoys.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed vice minister of personnel and sent again to the Huai frontier. By courier memorial he said, "Sending envoys and deploying troops should proceed together: envoys to fulfill all ritual propriety, troops to guard against sudden change. There is no need to wait until the Jurchen letter arrives before sending envoys.

sentences.zh: 書中或有見脅之語，不若先遣以釋其疑，于計為得。

translations.literal: If the letter contains language that seems coercive, it would be better to send envoys first to dispel their suspicion — that would be the better plan.
translations.idiomatic: If the letter contains language that seems coercive, it would be better to send envoys first to dispel their suspicion. That would be the better plan.

sentences.zh: 」上云：「端禮所奏未是。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "What Duanli memorializes is not correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What Duanli memorializes is not correct.

sentences.zh: 」思退傳旨撤海、泗二州戍兵，語在《思退傳》。

translations.literal: " Situi transmitted an order withdrawing garrison troops from Haizhou and Sizhou — the account is in Situi's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Situi transmitted an order withdrawing garrison troops from Haizhou and Sizhou. The account is given in Situi's biography.

sentences.zh: 金帥僕散忠義分兵入，上意中悔，令思退都督江、淮軍馬，端禮試兵部尚書，參贊軍事。

translations.literal: The Jurchen commander Puxie Zhongyi divided his forces and entered; the Emperor's mind turned to regret; he ordered Situi to command Jiang-Huai forces; Duanli was given acting appointment as Minister of War to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen commander Puxie Zhongyi divided his forces and invaded. The Emperor's mind turned to regret. He ordered Situi to command the Jiang-Huai forces, and Duanli was given acting appointment as minister of war to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 思退畏怯不行，端禮赴闕，上曰：「前後廷臣議論，獨卿不變。

translations.literal: Situi, timid, would not go; Duanli came to court; the Emperor said: "Among court ministers debating back and forth, you alone have not changed.
translations.idiomatic: Situi, timid, would not go. Duanli came to court, and the Emperor said, "Among court ministers debating back and forth, you alone have not changed.

sentences.zh: 」兼戶部尚書，俄拜端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: " He was given concurrent appointment as Minister of Revenue, and soon after was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall, Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He was given concurrent appointment as minister of revenue, and soon after was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall, deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and acting vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 上嘗問：「欲遣楊由義持金帥書，而辭行甚力，誰可遣？

translations.literal: The Emperor once asked: "I wish to send Yang Youyi with the Jurchen commander's letter, but he refuses the mission with great force — who can be sent?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor once asked, "I wish to send Yang Youyi with the Jurchen commander's letter, but he refuses the mission with great force. Who can be sent?

sentences.zh: 」端禮請以王抃行，俾與金帥議，許割商、秦地，歸被俘人，惟叛亡者不與，餘誓目略同紹興，世為叔侄之國，減銀絹五萬，易歲貢為歲幣。

translations.literal: " Duanli proposed sending Wang Bian to negotiate with the Jurchen commander: cede Shang and Qin territories, return captured persons, except deserters; other oath terms largely followed Shaoxing — perpetual uncle-and-nephew states, reduce silver and silk tribute by 50,000, change annual tribute to annual payments.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli proposed sending Wang Bian to negotiate with the Jurchen commander: cede Shang and Qin territories, return captured persons except deserters; other oath terms largely followed the Shaoxing settlement — perpetual uncle-and-nephew states, reduce silver and silk tribute by 50,000, and change annual tribute to annual payments.

sentences.zh: 及抃還，上見書，金皆聽許。

translations.literal: When Bian returned, the Emperor saw the letter; the Jurchens agreed to all terms.
translations.idiomatic: When Bian returned, the Emperor saw the letter. The Jurchens agreed to all terms.

sentences.zh: 端禮贊上如其式報之：「謀國當思遠圖，如與之和，則我得休息以修內治，若為忿兵，未見其可。

translations.literal: Duanli urged the Emperor to reply in like form: "In planning for the state one must think long-term; if we make peace, we gain rest to improve internal governance; if we march in anger, I see no assurance of success.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli urged the Emperor to reply in like form: "In planning for the state one must think long-term. If we make peace, we gain rest to improve internal governance. If we march in anger, I see no assurance of success.

sentences.zh: 」抃遂行。

translations.literal: " Bian then set out.
translations.idiomatic: Bian then set out.

sentences.zh: 諜報北軍已回，端禮以和議既定，乞降詔。

translations.literal: Spies reported northern armies had withdrawn; Duanli, as peace was settled, begged an edict proclaiming it.
translations.idiomatic: Spies reported that northern armies had withdrawn. Duanli, as peace was settled, begged that an edict proclaiming it be issued.

sentences.zh: 除參知政事兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Grand Councilor concurrently Acting Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice grand councilor concurrently acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 時久不置相，端禮以首參窺相位甚急。

translations.literal: As no Grand Councilor had been appointed for a long time, Duanli as senior Vice Councilor eagerly sought the top post.
translations.idiomatic: As no grand councilor had been appointed for a long time, Duanli as senior vice councilor eagerly sought the top post.

sentences.zh: 皇長子鄧王夫人，端禮女也，殿中侍御史唐堯封論端禮帝姻，不可任執政，不報，遷太常少卿。

translations.literal: The consort of the Emperor's eldest son, the Prince of Deng, was Duanli's daughter; Palace Attendant Tang Yaofeng argued that Duanli as imperial in-law could not hold executive power — no response; he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The consort of the Emperor's eldest son, the Prince of Deng, was Duanli's daughter. Palace attendant Tang Yaofeng argued that Duanli as imperial in-law could not hold executive power. There was no response, and Tang was transferred to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 館閣士相與上疏排端禮，皆坐絀。

translations.literal: Academicians of the Institute collectively memorialized against Duanli; all were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians of the Institute collectively memorialized against Duanli. All were demoted.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎王茀陰附端禮，建為「國是」之說以助其勢。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Wang Fu secretly aligned with Duanli and devised a doctrine of "national policy" to bolster his faction.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of justice Wang Fu secretly aligned with Duanli and devised a doctrine of "national policy" to bolster his faction.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎陳俊卿抗疏，力詆其罪，且謂本朝無以戚屬為相，此懼不可為子孫法。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Chen Junqing submitted a forceful memorial denouncing his crimes and stating that this dynasty has never made an in-law Grand Councilor — a precedent to be feared for posterity.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of personnel Chen Junqing submitted a forceful memorial denouncing his crimes and stating that this dynasty has never made an in-law grand councilor — a precedent to be feared for posterity.

sentences.zh: 逮進讀《寶訓》，適及外戚，因言：「祖宗家法，外戚不與政，最有深意，陛下所宜守。

translations.literal: When reading the Imperial Instructions, the section on consorts of foreign origin came up; he said: "The ancestral house law keeping consorts from government carries profound meaning; Your Majesty should uphold it.
translations.idiomatic: When reading the Imperial Instructions, the section on consorts of foreign origin came up. He said, "The ancestral house law keeping consorts from government carries profound meaning. Your Majesty should uphold it.

sentences.zh: 」上納其言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted his words.

sentences.zh: 端禮憾之，出俊卿知建寧府。

translations.literal: Duanli resented this and had Junqing sent out as Prefect of Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli resented this and had Junqing sent out as prefect of Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鄧王夫人生子，太上甚喜。

translations.literal: When the consort of the Prince of Deng gave birth, the Retired Emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the consort of the Prince of Deng gave birth, the Retired Emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 先兩月，恭王夫人李氏亦生子，於是恭王府直講王淮白端禮云：「恭王夫人子是為皇長嫡孫。

translations.literal: Two months earlier the consort of the Prince of Gong, Lady Li, had also given birth; the Lecturer Wang Huai of the Prince of Gong's household told Duanli: "The son of the Prince of Gong's consort is the eldest legitimate grandson of the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Two months earlier the consort of the Prince of Gong, Lady Li, had also given birth. The lecturer Wang Huai of the Prince of Gong's household told Duanli, "The son of the Prince of Gong's consort is the eldest legitimate grandson of the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 」端禮不懌，翌日奏：「嫡庶具載《禮經》，講官當以正論輔導，不應為此邪說。

translations.literal: " Duanli was displeased; the next day he memorialized: "Primary and secondary wives are fully recorded in the Book of Rites; lecturers should guide with correct doctrine and should not propagate such heterodox views.
translations.idiomatic: Duanli was displeased. The next day he memorialized, "Primary and secondary wives are fully recorded in the Book of Rites. Lecturers should guide with correct doctrine and should not propagate such heterodox views.

sentences.zh: 」 遂指淮傾邪不正，與外任。

translations.literal: " He then accused Huai of perverse bias and had him sent to an outside post.
translations.idiomatic: He then accused Huai of perverse bias and had him sent to an outside post.

sentences.zh: 鄧王立為太子，端禮引嫌，除資政殿大學士、提舉德壽宮兼侍讀，改提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Deng was established as Crown Prince, Duanli cited conflict of interest and was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, Commissioner of the Deshou Palace with concurrent Reader, then transferred to Commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Deng was established as crown prince, Duanli cited conflict of interest and was appointed grand academician of the Hall of Literary Policy, commissioner of the Deshou Palace with concurrent reader, then transferred to commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 起知寧國府，移紹興，進觀文殿學士。

translations.literal: He was recalled as Prefect of Ningguo Prefecture, transferred to Shaoxing, and promoted to Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as prefect of Ningguo Prefecture, transferred to Shaoxing, and promoted to grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature.

sentences.zh: 魏杞，字南夫，壽春人。

translations.literal: Wei Qi, style name Nanfu, was a native of Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi, courtesy name Nanfu, was a native of Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 祖蔭入官。

translations.literal: His grandfather entered office by hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather entered office by hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 紹興十二年，登進士第。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi civil examination.

sentences.zh: 知宣州涇縣。

translations.literal: He was Magistrate of Jing County in Xuanzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Jing County in Xuanzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 從臣錢端禮薦其才，召對，擢太府寺主簿，進丞。

translations.literal: Attendant Chen Qian Duanli recommended his talent; summoned for audience, he was promoted to Registrar of the Court of the Imperial Granary and then to Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Chen Qian Duanli recommended his talent. Summoned for audience, he was promoted to registrar of the Court of the Imperial Granary and then to assistant director.

sentences.zh: 端禮宣諭淮東，杞以考功員外郎為參議官，遷宗正少卿。

translations.literal: When Duanli was Commissioner to Pacify Huaidong, Qi served as Consultant Officer with the rank of Director in the Ministry of Personnel; he was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Duanli was commissioner to pacify Huaidong, Qi served as consultant officer with the rank of director in the Ministry of Personnel. He was transferred to vice director of the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 湯思退建和議，命杞為金通問使，孝宗面諭：「今遣使，一正名，二退師，三減歲幣，四不發歸附人。

translations.literal: Tang Situi established the peace settlement and appointed Qi as envoy to inquire of the Jurchens; Emperor Xiaozong instructed him face to face: "In sending this envoy: first, rectify titles; second, withdraw troops; third, reduce annual payments; fourth, do not send back defectors.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi established the peace settlement and appointed Qi as envoy to inquire of the Jurchens. Emperor Xiaozong instructed him face to face, "In sending this envoy: first, rectify titles; second, withdraw troops; third, reduce annual payments; fourth, do not send back defectors.

sentences.zh: 」杞條上十七事擬問對，上隨事畫可。

translations.literal: " Qi submitted seventeen proposed questions and answers item by item; the Emperor approved each as it arose.
translations.idiomatic: Qi submitted seventeen proposed questions and answers item by item. The Emperor approved each as it arose.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，奏曰：「臣若將指出疆，其敢不勉。

translations.literal: At farewell audience he memorialized: "If Your Majesty sends me as commissioner beyond the border, how could I not exert myself?
translations.idiomatic: At farewell audience he memorialized, "If Your Majesty sends me as commissioner beyond the border, how could I not exert myself?

sentences.zh: 萬一無厭，願速加兵。

translations.literal: If they prove insatiable, I pray reinforcements be added swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: If they prove insatiable, I pray reinforcements be added swiftly.

sentences.zh: 」上善之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 行次盱眙，金所遣大將僕散忠義、紇石烈志寧等方擁兵闖淮，遣權泗州趙房長問所以來意，求觀國書，杞曰：「書御封也，見主當廷授。

translations.literal: At Xuyi on the journey, the Jurchen generals Puxie Zhongyi, Hexilie Zhining, and others were just leading troops across the Huai; Qi sent Zhao Fangchang, acting Prefect of Sizhou, to ask their purpose and request to see the imperial letter; Qi said: "The letter is sealed by the Emperor; it shall be presented at court before the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuyi on the journey, the Jurchen generals Puxie Zhongyi, Hexilie Zhining, and others were just leading troops across the Huai. Qi sent Zhao Fangchang, acting prefect of Sizhou, to ask their purpose and request to see the imperial letter. Qi said, "The letter is sealed by the Emperor. It shall be presented at court before the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」房長馳白僕散忠義，疑國書不如式，又求割商、秦地及歸正人，且欲歲幣二十萬。

translations.literal: Fangchang galloped to report to Puxie Zhongyi, suspecting the imperial letter did not follow the proper form; he also demanded cession of Shang and Qin territories and return of defectors, and wanted annual payments of 200,000.
translations.idiomatic: Fangchang galloped to report to Puxie Zhongyi, suspecting the imperial letter did not follow the proper form. He also demanded cession of Shang and Qin territories and return of defectors, and wanted annual payments of 200,000.

sentences.zh: 杞以聞，上命盡依初式，再易國書，歲幣亦如其數。

translations.literal: Qi reported this; the Emperor ordered that the original form be fully followed, the imperial letter be rewritten, and the annual payments likewise set at that amount.
translations.idiomatic: Qi reported this. The Emperor ordered that the original form be fully followed, the imperial letter be rewritten, and the annual payments likewise set at that amount.

sentences.zh: 忠義以未如所欲，遂與志寧分兵犯山陽。

translations.literal: Zhongyi, as his wishes were not fully met, then divided forces with Zhining and invaded Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Because his wishes were not fully met, Zhongyi then divided forces with Zhining and invaded Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 戰不利，驍將魏勝死之。

translations.literal: The battle went badly, and the fierce general Wei Sheng was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The battle went badly, and the fierce general Wei Sheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 上怒金反覆，詔以禮物犒督府師，杞奏：「金若從約，而金繒不具，豈不瘠國體、格事機乎？

translations.literal: The Emperor, angered at Jurchen duplicity, ordered gifts sent to reward the commandery forces; Qi memorialized: "If the Jurchens abide by the treaty yet gold and silk are not prepared, would this not emaciate the state's dignity and obstruct the moment?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, angered at Jurchen duplicity, ordered gifts sent to reward the commandery forces. Qi memorialized, "If the Jurchens abide by the treaty yet gold and silk are not prepared, would this not emaciate the state's dignity and obstruct the moment?"

sentences.zh: 」乃以禮物行。

translations.literal: " Gifts were then sent.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts were then sent.

sentences.zh: 至燕，見金主褒，具言：「 天子神聖，才傑奮起，人人有敵愾意，北朝用兵能保必勝乎？

translations.literal: Arriving in Yan, he saw the Jurchen ruler Bao and fully stated: "The Son of Heaven is divine; talented men rise up; every man burns with hatred of the enemy. Can the northern court wage war and guarantee victory?"
translations.idiomatic: Arriving in Yan, he saw the Jurchen ruler Bao and fully stated, "The Son of Heaven is divine; talented men rise up; every man burns with hatred of the enemy. Can the northern court wage war and guarantee victory?"

sentences.zh: 和則兩國享其福，戰則將士蒙其利，昔人論之甚悉。

translations.literal: If we make peace, both states enjoy its blessings; if we fight, officers and soldiers bear its costs — men of old discussed this very thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: If we make peace, both states enjoy its blessings; if we fight, officers and soldiers bear its costs. Men of old discussed this very thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 」金君臣環聽拱竦。

translations.literal: " The Jurchen ruler and ministers listened in a circle, hands clasped in awe.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen ruler and ministers listened in a circle, hands clasped in awe.

sentences.zh: 館伴張恭愈以國書稱「大宋」，脅去「大」字，杞拒之，卒正敵國體，損歲幣五萬，不發歸正人北還。

translations.literal: The escort Zhang Gongyu, because the imperial letter used "Great Song," coerced removal of the character "Great"; Qi refused, and in the end corrected the enemy state's standing, reduced annual payments by 50,000, and did not send defectors back north.
translations.idiomatic: The escort Zhang Gongyu, because the imperial letter used "Great Song," coerced removal of the character "Great." Qi refused, and in the end corrected the enemy state's standing, reduced annual payments by 50,000, and did not send defectors back north.

sentences.zh: 上慰藉甚渥。

translations.literal: The Emperor's consolation was very generous.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's consolation was very generous.

sentences.zh: 守起居舍人，遷給事中、同知樞密院事，進參知政事、右僕射兼樞密使。

translations.literal: He served as Attendant Drafting Officer, was promoted to Supervising Censor and Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and advanced to Vice Grand Councilor, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He served as attendant drafting officer, was promoted to supervising censor and deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and advanced to vice grand councilor, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 時方借職田助邊，降人蕭鷓巴賜淮南田，意不愜，以職田請，杞言：「圭租食功養廉，借之尚可，奪之不可。

translations.literal: At the time office lands were being borrowed to aid the frontier; the surrendered man Xiao Zheba was granted lands in Huainan but was dissatisfied and requested office lands instead; Qi said: "Official rent feeds merit and sustains integrity — to borrow it is still permissible, to seize it is not."
translations.idiomatic: At the time office lands were being borrowed to aid the frontier. The surrendered man Xiao Zheba was granted lands in Huainan but was dissatisfied and requested office lands instead. Qi said, "Official rent feeds merit and sustains integrity. To borrow it is still permissible; to seize it is not."

sentences.zh: 」上是其言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 杞以使金不辱命，繇庶官一歲至相位。

translations.literal: Because Qi as envoy to the Jurchens did not disgrace his mission, he rose from a common official in one year to the top post.
translations.idiomatic: Because Qi as envoy to the Jurchens did not disgrace his mission, he rose from a common official in one year to the top post.

sentences.zh: 上銳意恢復，杞左右其論。

translations.literal: The Emperor was keen to recover lost territory, and Qi swayed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was keen to recover lost territory, and Qi swayed his counsel.

sentences.zh: 會郊祀冬雷，用漢制災異策免，守左諫議大夫、提舉江州太平興國宮。

translations.literal: When thunder sounded in winter during the suburban sacrifice, following Han precedent for calamities and anomalies he was dismissed from office, remaining as Left Remonstrating Censor and Commissioner of the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When thunder sounded in winter during the suburban sacrifice, following Han precedent for calamities and anomalies he was dismissed from office, remaining as left remonstrating censor and commissioner of the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，授觀文殿學士、知平江府。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 諫官王希呂論杞貪墨，奪職。

translations.literal: Remonstrating official Wang Xilu accused Qi of corruption and greed; his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating official Wang Xilu accused Qi of corruption and greed, and his office was stripped.

sentences.zh: 後以端明殿學士奉祠，告老，復資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: Later, as Academician of the Duanming Hall he held a sinecure post, reported old age, and was again made Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as academician of the Duanming Hall he held a sinecure post, reported old age, and was again made grand academician of the Hall of Literary Policy.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十一年十一月薨，贈特進。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Chunxi he died; he was posthumously awarded Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Chunxi he died; he was posthumously awarded special advancement.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰中，諡「文節」。

translations.literal: During the Jiatai era he was given the posthumous title "Wenjie."
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiatai era he was given the posthumous title "Wenjie."

sentences.zh: 周葵，字立義，常州宜興人。

translations.literal: Zhou Kui, courtesy name Liyi, was a native of Yixing in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Kui, courtesy name Liyi, was a native of Yixing in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 少力學，自鄉校移籍京師，兩學傳誦其文。

translations.literal: From youth he studied diligently; he transferred his registration from the district school to the capital, and both academies circulated his writings.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he studied diligently. He transferred his registration from the district school to the capital, and both academies circulated his writings.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年，擢進士甲科。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuanhe he was selected in the top rank of the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xuanhe he was selected in the top rank of the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 調徽州推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed Investigating Officer in Huizhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating officer in Huizhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高宗移蹕臨安，諸軍交馳境上，葵與判官攝郡事，應變敏速，千里帖然。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong moved the court to Lin'an, armies crisscrossed the borders; Kui and the vice magistrate administered the prefecture, responding to changes with swift agility, and for a thousand li all was calm.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong moved the court to Lin'an, armies crisscrossed the borders. Kui and the vice magistrate administered the prefecture, responding to changes with swift agility, and for a thousand li all was calm.

sentences.zh: 教授臨安府，未上，吏部侍郎陳與義密薦之，召試館職。

translations.literal: He was appointed professor in Lin'an Prefecture but had not yet taken up the post when Vice Minister of Personnel Chen Yuyi secretly recommended him; he was summoned to test for an institute post.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed professor in Lin'an Prefecture but had not yet taken up the post when vice minister of personnel Chen Yuyi secretly recommended him. He was summoned to test for an institute post.

sentences.zh: 將試，復引對，高宗曰：「從班多說卿端正。」

translations.literal: Just before the test he was again summoned for audience; Emperor Gaozong said: "Many in the attendant ranks say you are upright."
translations.idiomatic: Just before the test he was again summoned for audience. Emperor Gaozong said, "Many in the attendant ranks say you are upright."

sentences.zh: 除監察御史，徙殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Investigating Censor and transferred to Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating censor and transferred to palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 在職僅兩月，言事至三十章，且歷條所行不當事凡二十條，指宰相不任責。

translations.literal: In office barely two months, he submitted memorials on affairs reaching thirty chapters, and in succession listed twenty improper actions, pointing out that the grand councilors did not bear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In office barely two months, he submitted memorials on affairs reaching thirty chapters, and in succession listed twenty improper actions, pointing out that the grand councilors did not bear responsibility.

sentences.zh: 高宗變色曰：「趙鼎、張浚肯任事，須假之權，奈何遽以小事形跡之？

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong changed color and said: "Zhao Ding and Zhang Jun are willing to take responsibility — one must lend them authority. Why suddenly use small matters to expose their conduct?"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong changed color and said, "Zhao Ding and Zhang Jun are willing to take responsibility. One must lend them authority. Why suddenly use small matters to expose their conduct?"

sentences.zh: 」葵曰：「陛下即位，已相十許人，其初皆極意委之，卒以公議不容而去，大臣亦無固志。

translations.literal: Kui said: "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, you have already appointed some ten grand councilors; at first you entrusted each with full intent, yet in the end public opinion would not tolerate them and they left — the grand councilors too had no firm will."
translations.idiomatic: Kui said, "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, you have already appointed some ten grand councilors. At first you entrusted each with full intent, yet in the end public opinion would not tolerate them and they left. The grand councilors too had no firm will."

sentences.zh: 假如陛下有過，尚望大臣盡忠，豈大臣有過，而言者一指，乃便為形跡，使彼過而不改，罪戾日深，非所以保全之也。

translations.literal: Suppose Your Majesty had faults — one would still hope grand councilors would serve with full loyalty. How can it be that when grand councilors have faults and remonstrators point them out, one immediately treats it as exposing conduct, so that their faults go uncorrected and guilt deepens daily? That is not how to preserve them.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose Your Majesty had faults — one would still hope grand councilors would serve with full loyalty. How can it be that when grand councilors have faults and remonstrators point them out, one immediately treats it as exposing conduct, so that their faults go uncorrected and guilt deepens daily? That is not how to preserve them.

sentences.zh: 」高宗改容曰：「此論甚奇。」

translations.literal: " Emperor Gaozong changed expression and said: "This argument is quite remarkable."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong changed expression and said, "This argument is quite remarkable."

sentences.zh: 張浚議北伐，葵三章力言此存亡之機，非獨安危所係。

translations.literal: When Zhang Jun debated a northern expedition, Kui submitted three memorials forcefully stating that this was a matter of survival and extinction, not merely safety and danger.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Jun debated a northern expedition, Kui submitted three memorials forcefully stating that this was a matter of survival and extinction, not merely safety and danger.

sentences.zh: 或言葵沮大計，罷為司農少卿，以直秘閣知信州。

translations.literal: Some said Kui was obstructing the great plan; he was dismissed as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Granaries and appointed Direct Access to the Secret Archive as Prefect of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Some said Kui was obstructing the great plan. He was dismissed as vice director of the Court of Imperial Granaries and appointed direct access to the Secret Archive as prefect of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 未上，鼎罷，陳與義執政，改湖南提刑，以親老易江東，皆不就。

translations.literal: Before he took up the post, Ding was dismissed; Chen Yuyi held power and changed his appointment to Fiscal Intendant of Hunan; because his parents were old he sought transfer to Jiangdong — he accepted neither.
translations.idiomatic: Before he took up the post, Ding was dismissed. Chen Yuyi held power and changed his appointment to fiscal intendant of Hunan. Because his parents were old he sought transfer to Jiangdong — he accepted neither.

sentences.zh: 和議已定，被召，論：「為國有道，戰則勝，守則固，和則久。

translations.literal: Once peace was settled, he was recalled and argued: "Governing a state has its way: in war one prevails, in defense one holds firm, in peace one endures.
translations.idiomatic: Once peace was settled, he was recalled and argued, "Governing a state has its way: in war one prevails, in defense one holds firm, in peace one endures.

sentences.zh: 不然，三者在人不在我矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise, all three depend on others, not on us.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, all three depend on others, not on us."

sentences.zh: 」除太常少卿。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 時秦檜獨相，意葵前論事去，必憾趙鼎，再除殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: At the time Qin Hui alone was grand councilor; he thought Kui had left office over earlier remonstrances and must resent Zhao Ding, and again appointed him Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qin Hui alone was grand councilor. He thought Kui had left office over earlier remonstrances and must resent Zhao Ding, and again appointed him palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 葵語人曰：「元鎮已貶，葵固不言，雖門下客亦不及之也。

translations.literal: Kui told others: "Yuanzhen has already been demoted; Kui will certainly not speak of it — not even to clients at my gate."
translations.idiomatic: Kui told others, "Yuanzhen has already been demoted. Kui will certainly not speak of it — not even to clients at my gate."

sentences.zh: 」內降差除四人，奏言：「願陛下以仁祖為法，大臣以杜衍為法。

translations.literal: " An inner edict specially appointed four men; he memorialized: "I pray Your Majesty take Emperor Renzong as your model and grand councilors take Du Yan as theirs."
translations.idiomatic: An inner edict specially appointed four men. He memorialized, "I pray Your Majesty take Emperor Renzong as your model and grand councilors take Du Yan as theirs."

sentences.zh: 」檜始不樂。

translations.literal: Hui was displeased at first.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was displeased at first.

sentences.zh: 又論國用、軍政、士民三弊，高宗曰：「國用當藏之民，百姓足則國用非所患。

translations.literal: He also discussed three abuses — state finances, military administration, and scholars and people; Emperor Gaozong said: "State finances should be stored with the people; when the common people are sufficient, state finances are not what one need worry about."
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed three abuses — state finances, military administration, and scholars and people. Emperor Gaozong said, "State finances should be stored with the people. When the common people are sufficient, state finances are not what one need worry about."

sentences.zh: 」又言薦舉改官之弊，宜聽減舉員，詔吏部措置。

translations.literal: " He also spoke on abuses in recommendation and promotion; he begged that the number of recommenders be reduced, and an edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel to arrange it.
translations.idiomatic: He also spoke on abuses in recommendation and promotion and begged that the number of recommenders be reduced. An edict ordered the Ministry of Personnel to arrange it.

sentences.zh: 檜所厚權戶部尚書梁汝嘉將特賜出身，除兩府，汝嘉聞葵欲劾之，謂中書舍人林待聘曰：「副端將論君矣。

translations.literal: Liang Rujia, whom Hui favored as acting Minister of Revenue, was about to be specially granted initial appointment and dual palace posts; Rujia heard Kui intended to impeach him and told Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery Lin Daipin: "The deputy censor is about to criticize you."
translations.idiomatic: Liang Rujia, whom Hui favored as acting minister of revenue, was about to be specially granted initial appointment and dual palace posts. Rujia heard Kui intended to impeach him and told vice director of the Secretariat-Chancellery Lin Daipin, "The deputy censor is about to criticize you."

sentences.zh: 」待聘乘檜未趨朝，亟告之，檜即奏為起居郎。

translations.literal: Daipin, while Hui had not yet gone to court, urgently told him; Hui immediately memorialized for Kui's appointment as Attendant Drafting Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Daipin, while Hui had not yet gone to court, urgently told him. Hui immediately memorialized for Kui's appointment as attendant drafting officer.

sentences.zh: 葵方待引，檜下殿諭閣門曰：「周葵已得旨除起居郎。

translations.literal: Kui was just waiting to be presented when Hui descended from the hall and instructed the Gate Office: "Zhou Kui has already received the edict appointing him Attendant Drafting Officer."
translations.idiomatic: Kui was just waiting to be presented when Hui descended from the hall and instructed the Gate Office, "Zhou Kui has already received the edict appointing him attendant drafting officer."

sentences.zh: 」隔下。

translations.literal: " The curtain was lowered.
translations.idiomatic: The curtain was lowered.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰也。

translations.literal: It was the day gengchen in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: It was the day gengchen in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 參政李光擬除呂廣問館職，檜不許。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilor Li Guang proposed appointing Lü Guangwen to an institute post; Hui would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Vice grand councilor Li Guang proposed appointing Lü Guangwen to an institute post; Hui would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 時有詔從官薦士，葵以廣問應，初不相知也。

translations.literal: At the time there was an edict that attendant officials recommend scholars; Kui recommended Guangwen in response — they had not known each other before.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was an edict that attendant officials recommend scholars. Kui recommended Guangwen in response — they had not known each other before.

sentences.zh: 光既絀，葵以附會落職，主管玉隆觀。

translations.literal: When Guang was demoted, Kui was stripped of office for collusion and made Superintendent of the Yulong Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: When Guang was demoted, Kui was stripped of office for collusion and made superintendent of the Yulong Abbey.

sentences.zh: 復直秘閣，起知湖州，移平江府。

translations.literal: He was again given Direct Access to the Secret Archive, recalled as Prefect of Huzhou, and transferred to Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was again given direct access to the Secret Archive, recalled as prefect of Huzhou, and transferred to Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時金使絡繹於道，葵不為禮，轉運李椿年希檜旨劾之，落職，主管崇道觀。

translations.literal: At the time Jurchen envoys crowded the roads; Kui did not observe the proper rites. Transport Commissioner Li Chunnian, seeking Hui's intent, impeached him; he was stripped of office and made Superintendent of the Chongdao Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jurchen envoys crowded the roads. Kui did not observe the proper rites. Transport commissioner Li Chunnian, seeking Hui's intent, impeached him. He was stripped of office and made superintendent of the Chongdao Abbey.

sentences.zh: 屏居鄉閭，憂患頻仍，人不能堪，葵獨安之。

translations.literal: Living in seclusion in his home district, misfortunes came one after another — others could not bear it, yet Kui alone remained at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Living in seclusion in his home district, misfortunes came one after another. Others could not bear it, yet Kui alone remained at peace.

sentences.zh: 檜死，復直秘閣、知紹興府。

translations.literal: When Hui died, Kui was again given Direct Access to the Secret Archive and appointed Prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui died, Kui was again given direct access to the Secret Archive and appointed prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 過闕，權禮部侍郎，尋兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: Passing the capital, he was acting Vice Minister of Rites, and soon also Chancellor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Passing the capital, he was acting vice minister of rites, and soon also chancellor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 奏：「科舉所以取士。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The civil examinations exist to select scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "The civil examinations exist to select scholars.

sentences.zh: 比年主司迎合大臣意，取經傳語可諛者為問目，學者競逐時好。

translations.literal: In recent years chief examiners have catered to grand councilors' wishes, selecting passages from the classics that can flatter for question topics; scholars compete to chase current fashion.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years chief examiners have catered to grand councilors' wishes, selecting passages from the classics that can flatter for question topics. Scholars compete to chase current fashion.

sentences.zh: 望詔國學並擇秋試考官，精選通經博古之士，置之前列，其穿鑿乖謬者黜之。」

translations.literal: I pray an edict that the Imperial University and autumn-exam chief examiners alike be chosen — select first those versed in the classics and broad in antiquity, and dismiss those who force strained interpretations and err grievously."
translations.idiomatic: I pray an edict that the Imperial University and autumn-exam chief examiners alike be chosen: select first those versed in the classics and broad in antiquity, and dismiss those who force strained interpretations and err grievously."

sentences.zh: 兼權給事中。

translations.literal: He also held concurrent appointment as Acting Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He also held concurrent appointment as acting supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 侍御史湯鵬舉言：「葵以魏良臣薦，躐處侍從；

translations.literal: Attending Censor Tang Pengju said: "Kui was recommended by Wei Liangchen and leaped to attendant rank;
translations.idiomatic: Attending censor Tang Pengju said, "Kui was recommended by Wei Liangchen and leaped to attendant rank;

sentences.zh: 呂廣問，葵之死黨。

translations.literal: Lü Guangwen is Kui's sworn faction.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Guangwen is Kui's sworn faction.

sentences.zh: 乞並罷之。

translations.literal: I beg that both be dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that both be dismissed."

sentences.zh: 」太學生黃作、詹淵率諸生都堂投牒留葵。

translations.literal: " Imperial University students Huang Zuo and Zhan Yuan led the students to the chief minister's gate to submit petitions asking Kui be retained.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial University students Huang Zuo and Zhan Yuan led the students to the chief minister's gate to submit petitions asking Kui be retained.

sentences.zh: 翌日，博士何俌等言於朝，乞懲戒，詔作、淵皆送五百里外州編管，葵出知信州，隨罷。

translations.literal: The next day Erudite He Fu and others spoke at court begging punishment; an edict ordered Zuo and Yuan both sent for registered exile five hundred li outside the prefecture; Kui was sent out as Prefect of Xinzhou and likewise dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day erudite He Fu and others spoke at court begging punishment. An edict ordered Zuo and Yuan both sent for registered exile five hundred li outside the prefecture. Kui was sent out as prefect of Xinzhou and likewise dismissed.

sentences.zh: 起知撫州，引疾，改提舉興國宮，加直龍圖閣、知太平州。

translations.literal: He was recalled as Prefect of Fuzhou, cited illness, changed to Commissioner of the Xingguo Palace, and promoted to Direct Access to the Dragon Diagram Hall as Prefect of Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as prefect of Fuzhou, cited illness, changed to commissioner of the Xingguo Palace, and promoted to direct access to the Dragon Diagram Hall as prefect of Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 水壞圩堤，悉繕完，凡百二十里。

translations.literal: Flood waters damaged the polder dikes; he repaired them all — one hundred twenty li in total.
translations.idiomatic: Flood waters damaged the polder dikes. He repaired them all — one hundred twenty li in total.

sentences.zh: 傍郡圩皆沒，惟當塗歲熟。

translations.literal: Neighboring prefectures' polders were all submerged; only Dangtu had a full harvest that year.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring prefectures' polders were all submerged; only Dangtu had a full harvest that year.

sentences.zh: 市河久堙，雨暘交病，葵下令城中，家出一夫，官給之食，並力浚導，公私便之。

translations.literal: The market river had long been silted; drought and flood alternated in harm. Kui ordered every household in the city to supply one man; the government provided food, and all joined to dredge and channel — public and private alike benefited.
translations.idiomatic: The market river had long been silted; drought and flood alternated in harm. Kui ordered every household in the city to supply one man. The government provided food, and all joined to dredge and channel — public and private alike benefited.

sentences.zh: 進集英殿修撰、敷文閣待制、知婺州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Compiler in the Hall for Assembling Excellence, Awaiting Orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, and Prefect of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to compiler in the Hall for Assembling Excellence, awaiting orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, and prefect of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，除兵部侍郎兼侍講，改同知貢舉兼權戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, he was appointed Vice Minister of War with concurrent Reader, changed to Deputy Director of the Examinations with concurrent Acting Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, he was appointed vice minister of war with concurrent reader, changed to deputy director of the examinations with concurrent acting vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 孝宗數手詔問錢穀出入，葵奏：「陛下勞心庶政，日有諮詢，若出人意表。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong repeatedly sent handwritten edicts asking about revenue and expenditure; Kui memorialized: "Your Majesty toils over myriad policies and daily seeks consultation — if matters fall outside what people expect.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong repeatedly sent handwritten edicts asking about revenue and expenditure. Kui memorialized, "Your Majesty toils over myriad policies and daily seeks consultation — if matters fall outside what people expect.

sentences.zh: 今皆微文細故，此必有小人乘間欲售其私，不可不察。

translations.literal: Now all are petty documents and minor affairs — there must be petty men seizing the interval to sell their private interests; this cannot go unexamined.
translations.idiomatic: Now all are petty documents and minor affairs. There must be petty men seizing the interval to sell their private interests. This cannot go unexamined."

sentences.zh: 」蓋指龍大淵、曾覿也。

translations.literal: This referred to Long Dayuan and Zeng Di.
translations.idiomatic: This referred to Long Dayuan and Zeng Di.

sentences.zh: 孝宗色為動。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong's expression changed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong's expression changed.

sentences.zh: 金主亮為其下所斃，張浚自督府來朝，密言：「敵失泗州，其懼罪者皆欲來歸，願遣軍渡淮赴之，此恢復之機也。

translations.literal: The Jurchen ruler Haili was killed by his subordinates; Zhang Jun came from the commandery to court and secretly said: "The enemy lost Sizhou; those who fear punishment all wish to come over. Send troops across the Huai to meet them — this is the moment for recovery."
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen ruler Haili was killed by his subordinates. Zhang Jun came from the commandery to court and secretly said, "The enemy lost Sizhou. Those who fear punishment all wish to come over. Send troops across the Huai to meet them — this is the moment for recovery."

sentences.zh: 」葵請對，謂不可輕舉，累數百言。

translations.literal: Kui sought audience and argued it should not be lightly attempted, piling up several hundred words.
translations.idiomatic: Kui sought audience and argued it should not be lightly attempted, piling up several hundred words.

sentences.zh: 及遣李顯忠、邵宏淵取靈壁、虹二縣，敗績。

translations.literal: When Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan were sent to take Lingbi and Hong counties, they suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan were sent to take Lingbi and Hong counties, they suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 孝宗思其言，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong recalled his words and appointed him Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong recalled his words and appointed him vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 葵始終守自治之說。

translations.literal: Kui consistently upheld the doctrine of self-governance.
translations.idiomatic: Kui consistently upheld the doctrine of self-governance.

sentences.zh: 兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He also held concurrent appointment as Acting Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He also held concurrent appointment as acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 臺諫交章言議和太速，葵與陳康伯、湯思退乞令侍從、臺諫集議，眾益洶洶，諸公待罪乞罷，不許。

translations.literal: Censors and remonstrators submitted successive memorials saying peace was negotiated too hastily; Kui with Chen Kangbo and Tang Situi begged that attendants and remonstrators assemble for joint discussion; the crowd grew ever more clamorous; the officials offered resignation begging dismissal — not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Censors and remonstrators submitted successive memorials saying peace was negotiated too hastily. Kui with Chen Kangbo and Tang Situi begged that attendants and remonstrators assemble for joint discussion. The crowd grew ever more clamorous. The officials offered resignation begging dismissal — not permitted.

sentences.zh: 葵獨留身固請，孝宗曰：「卿何請之力也？

translations.literal: Kui alone remained and forcefully begged leave; Emperor Xiaozong said: "Why do you beg so forcefully?"
translations.idiomatic: Kui alone remained and forcefully begged leave. Emperor Xiaozong said, "Why do you beg so forcefully?"

sentences.zh: 」曰：「自預政以來，每與宰相論事，有以為然而從者；

translations.literal: He said: "Since entering government, whenever I discuss affairs with the grand councilor, sometimes he agrees and follows;
translations.idiomatic: He said, "Since entering government, whenever I discuss affairs with the grand councilor, sometimes he agrees and follows;

sentences.zh: 有不得以強從者；

translations.literal: sometimes he cannot agree but is forced to follow;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he cannot agree but is forced to follow;

sentences.zh: 有絕不肯從者，十常四五。

translations.literal: sometimes he absolutely refuses to follow — ten times in four or five.
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he absolutely refuses to follow — ten times in four or five.

sentences.zh: 洎至榻前，陛下又或不然，大率十事之中，不從者七八，安得不愧於心，此臣所以欲去也。」

translations.literal: When it comes before Your Majesty's couch, Your Majesty again sometimes disagrees — broadly speaking, of ten matters seven or eight are not followed. How can I not feel ashamed at heart? That is why I wish to leave."
translations.idiomatic: When it comes before Your Majesty's couch, Your Majesty again sometimes disagrees. Broadly speaking, of ten matters seven or eight are not followed. How can I not feel ashamed at heart? That is why I wish to leave."

sentences.zh: 嘗乞召用侍從、臺諫，孝宗曰：「安得如卿直諒者。

translations.literal: He once begged to recall attendants and remonstrators; Emperor Xiaozong said: "Where can one find someone as straight and candid as you?"
translations.idiomatic: He once begged to recall attendants and remonstrators. Emperor Xiaozong said, "Where can one find someone as straight and candid as you?"

sentences.zh: 」遂薦李浩、龔茂良，孝宗皆以為佳士，次第用之。

translations.literal: He then recommended Li Hao and Gong Maoliang; Emperor Xiaozong considered both excellent men and employed them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He then recommended Li Hao and Gong Maoliang. Emperor Xiaozong considered both excellent men and employed them in succession.

sentences.zh: 太常奏郊牛斃，葵言：「《春秋》鼷鼠食牛角免郊，況邊虞未靖，請展郊以符天意。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported the suburban ox had died; Kui said: "In the Spring and Autumn Annals, a rat gnawed an ox's horn and the suburban sacrifice was exempted — how much more when frontier alarms are not yet settled? I pray the suburban sacrifice be postponed to accord with Heaven's intent."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported the suburban ox had died. Kui said, "In the Spring and Autumn Annals, a rat gnawed an ox's horn and the suburban sacrifice was exempted — how much more when frontier alarms are not yet settled? I pray the suburban sacrifice be postponed to accord with Heaven's intent."

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed his request.

sentences.zh: 葵孝於事親，當任子，先孤侄。

translations.literal: Kui was filial in serving his parents; when entitled to appoint a son, he first appointed a nephew who had lost his father.
translations.idiomatic: Kui was filial in serving his parents. When entitled to appoint a son, he first appointed a nephew who had lost his father.

sentences.zh: 其薨也，幼子與孫尚未命。

translations.literal: When he died, his youngest son and grandson had not yet received appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, his youngest son and grandson had not yet received appointments.

sentences.zh: 平生學問不泥傳注，作《聖傳詩》二十篇、文集三十卷、奏議五卷。

translations.literal: His lifelong learning did not cling to transmitted commentaries; he wrote twenty chapters of Odes on the Sage's Transmission, thirty juan of collected writings, and five juan of memorials.
translations.idiomatic: His lifelong learning did not cling to transmitted commentaries. He wrote twenty chapters of Odes on the Sage's Transmission, thirty juan of collected writings, and five juan of memorials.

sentences.zh: 晚號惟心居士。

translations.literal: In his later years he styled himself the Lay Buddhist of Only Mind.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he styled himself the Lay Buddhist of Only Mind.

sentences.zh: 四年，有司請諡，賜諡曰「惠簡」。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the responsible offices requested a posthumous title; he was granted the posthumous title "Huijian."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the responsible offices requested a posthumous title; he was granted the posthumous title "Huijian."

sentences.zh: 施師點

translations.literal: Shi Shidian
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shidian

sentences.zh: 施師點，字聖與，上饒人。

translations.literal: Shi Shidian, style name Shengyu, was a native of Shangrao.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shidian, courtesy name Shengyu, was a native of Shangrao.

sentences.zh: 十歲通《六經》，十二能文。

translations.literal: At ten he mastered the Six Classics; at twelve he could write essays.
translations.idiomatic: At ten he mastered the Six Classics; at twelve he could write essays.

sentences.zh: 弱冠遊太學，試每在前列，司業高宏稱其文深醇有古風。

translations.literal: In early manhood he studied at the Imperial University; in examinations he always ranked at the front; Vice Director Gao Hong praised his writing as deep, pure, and in an ancient style.
translations.idiomatic: In early manhood he studied at the Imperial University. In examinations he always ranked at the front. Vice director Gao Hong praised his writing as deep, pure, and in an ancient style.

sentences.zh: 尋授以學職，以舍選奉廷對，調復州教授。

translations.literal: Soon he was granted a teaching post; selected by dormitory for palace audience, he was assigned as Professor in Fuzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was granted a teaching post. Selected by dormitory for palace audience, he was assigned as professor in Fuzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未上，丁內艱。

translations.literal: Before taking up the post, he entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Before taking up the post, he entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服除，為臨安府教授。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he became Professor in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he became professor in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年，兼權禮部侍郎，除給事中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he held concurrent appointment as Acting Vice Minister of Rites and was appointed Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he held concurrent appointment as acting vice minister of rites and was appointed supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 時太子詹事已除，上又特令增員為二，命兼之。

translations.literal: At the time the post of Aide to the Crown Prince had already been filled; the Emperor also specially ordered the number increased to two and commanded Shidian to hold one concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the post of aide to the crown prince had already been filled. The Emperor also specially ordered the number increased to two and commanded Shidian to hold one concurrently.

sentences.zh: 賜對，言：「比年人物骫骳，士氣耗苶，當廣儲人材以待用。

translations.literal: Granted audience, he said: "In recent years men have grown crooked and scholarly morale has withered; talent should be broadly stored for use."
translations.idiomatic: Granted audience, he said, "In recent years men have grown crooked and scholarly morale has withered. Talent should be broadly stored for use."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「觀卿所奏，公輔器也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "From what you have submitted, you are material for chief minister."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "From what you have submitted, you are material for chief minister."

sentences.zh: 假翰林學士、知制誥兼侍讀使金。

translations.literal: Acting Hanlin Academician, Drafting Officer with concurrent Reader, envoy to the Jurchens.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Hanlin academician, drafting officer with concurrent reader, envoy to the Jurchens.

sentences.zh: 致命金廷，立班既定，相儀者以親王將至，命師點退位，師點屹立。

translations.literal: Delivering the imperial message at the Jurchen court, once the formation was set, the protocol officer, because a prince was about to arrive, ordered Shidian to step back; Shidian stood firm.
translations.idiomatic: Delivering the imperial message at the Jurchen court, once the formation was set, the protocol officer, because a prince was about to arrive, ordered Shidian to step back. Shidian stood firm.

sentences.zh: 相儀者請數四，師點正色曰：「班立已定，尚欲何為。

translations.literal: The protocol officer requested four or five times; Shidian said sternly: "The formation is already set — what more do you want?"
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer requested four or five times. Shidian said sternly, "The formation is already set. What more do you want?"

sentences.zh: 」不肯少動。

translations.literal: " He would not move the slightest.
translations.idiomatic: He would not move the slightest.

sentences.zh: 在廷相顧駭愕，知其有守，不敢復以為請。

translations.literal: Those in court looked at one another in shock; knowing he had principle, they dared not request again.
