translations.idiomatic: Those in court looked at one another in shock. Knowing he had principle, they dared not request again.

sentences.zh: 九年，使還，有言其事於上者，上嘉歎不已。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when he returned from his mission, someone reported the matter to the Emperor, who praised him endlessly.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when he returned from his mission, someone reported the matter to the Emperor, who praised him endlessly.

sentences.zh: 及後金使賀正旦至闕，問館伴：「師點今居何官？

translations.literal: Later, when a Jurchen envoy came to court for New Year's congratulations, he asked the escort: "What office does Shidian hold now?"
translations.idiomatic: Later, when a Jurchen envoy came to court for New Year's congratulations, he asked the escort, "What office does Shidian hold now?"

sentences.zh: 」館伴宇文價于班列中指師點以示之，金使恍然曰：「一見正人，令人眼明。」

translations.literal: The escort Yuwen Jia pointed out Shidian in the formation; the Jurchen envoy said with sudden clarity: "To see an upright man once makes one's eyes bright."
translations.idiomatic: The escort Yuwen Jia pointed out Shidian in the formation. The Jurchen envoy said with sudden clarity, "To see an upright man once makes one's eyes bright."

sentences.zh: 十年，除端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Academician of the Duanming Hall and Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall and deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 入奏，控免，上曰：「卿靖重有守，識慮深遠，朕欲用卿久矣。

translations.literal: Entering to memorialize, he begged to decline; the Emperor said: "You are calm, principled, and far-sighted in judgment. I have long wished to employ you."
translations.idiomatic: Entering to memorialize, he begged to decline. The Emperor said, "You are calm, principled, and far-sighted in judgment. I have long wished to employ you."

sentences.zh: 」復詔兼參知政事，除參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: An edict again appointed him concurrently Vice Grand Councilor; he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor concurrently Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict again appointed him concurrently vice grand councilor. He was appointed vice grand councilor concurrently deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 師點嘗同宰相奏事退，復同樞密周必大進呈，上曰：「適一二事卿等各陳所見，甚關大體。

translations.literal: Shidian once memorialized with the grand councilor and withdrew, then with Military Affairs Director Zhou Bida entered to present; the Emperor said: "On one or two matters just now you each stated your views — very much to the larger pattern."
translations.idiomatic: Shidian once memorialized with the grand councilor and withdrew, then with military affairs director Zhou Bida entered to present. The Emperor said, "On one or two matters just now you each stated your views — very much to the larger pattern."

sentences.zh: 前此宰相奏事，執政不措辭，今卿等如此，深副所望。

translations.literal: Before this, when grand councilors memorialized, executive officials did not speak; now that you act thus, you deeply fulfill what I hope for.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, when grand councilors memorialized, executive officials did not speak. Now that you act thus, you deeply fulfill what I hope for.

sentences.zh: 」必大奏：「祖宗時，宰執奏事自相可否，或至面相切責，退不相銜。

translations.literal: Bida memorialized: "In the time of the ancestors, when grand councilors and executives memorialized, they approved or disapproved among themselves — sometimes even rebuked one another face to face and parted without speaking afterward."
translations.idiomatic: Bida memorialized, "In the time of the ancestors, when grand councilors and executives memorialized, they approved or disapproved among themselves — sometimes even rebuked one another face to face and parted without speaking afterward."

sentences.zh: 自秦檜用事，執政畏避不敢言。

translations.literal: Since Qin Hui held power, executives have feared and avoided speaking.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin Hui held power, executives have feared and avoided speaking.

sentences.zh: 今陛下虛心兼聽，若只宰相奏事，何用執政為？

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty listens with an open mind to all sides — if only the grand councilor memorializes, what need is there for executives?"
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty listens with an open mind to all sides. If only the grand councilor memorializes, what need is there for executives?"

sentences.zh: 」師點復奏：「臣敢不竭股肱之力。

translations.literal: Shidian again memorialized: "Your servant dares not fail to exert all strength as arms and legs."
translations.idiomatic: Shidian again memorialized, "Your servant dares not fail to exert all strength as arms and legs."

sentences.zh: 」上因諭之曰：「朕欲天下事日往來胸中，未嘗釋也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon instructed them: "I wish the affairs of the empire to flow daily into my breast — I never release them."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thereupon instructed them, "I wish the affairs of the empire to flow daily into my breast. I never release them."

sentences.zh: 先是，州郡上供或不以時進，立歲終稽考法，及是，主計臣有喜為督促者，乞不待歲終先期行之。

translations.literal: Previously, prefectural tribute to the capital was sometimes not submitted on schedule; a year-end audit law was established. At this time the chief accountant, pleased with urging, begged that it be implemented early without waiting for year's end.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, prefectural tribute to the capital was sometimes not submitted on schedule. A year-end audit law was established. At this time the chief accountant, pleased with urging, begged that it be implemented early without waiting for year's end.

sentences.zh: 畫命已下，師點矍然曰：「此策若行，上下逼迫，民不聊生。

translations.literal: The draft order had already been issued when Shidian started and said: "If this policy is implemented, superiors and inferiors will be driven hard and the people will have no peace."
translations.idiomatic: The draft order had already been issued when Shidian started and said, "If this policy is implemented, superiors and inferiors will be driven hard and the people will have no peace."

sentences.zh: 」或謂：「令已出矣。

translations.literal: Some said: "The order has already gone out."
translations.idiomatic: Some said, "The order has already gone out."

sentences.zh: 」師點曰：「事有為天下病，惟恨更之不速。

translations.literal: Shidian said: "When a matter is a sickness to the empire, one can only regret not changing it sooner."
translations.idiomatic: Shidian said, "When a matter is a sickness to the empire, one can only regret not changing it sooner."

sentences.zh: 」即追寢其議。

translations.literal: He immediately pursued and halted the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately pursued and halted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 樞密周必大舉手賀師點曰：「使天下赤子不被其毒者，公之賜也。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Director Zhou Bida raised his hands and congratulated Shidian: "That the newborn children of the empire are not poisoned by this is your gift."
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs director Zhou Bida raised his hands and congratulated Shidian, "That the newborn children of the empire are not poisoned by this is your gift."

sentences.zh: 」一日，入對後殿，上曰：「朕前飲冰水過多，忽暴下，幸即平復。

translations.literal: One day, after audience in the rear hall, the Emperor said: "I drank too much iced water earlier and suddenly had severe diarrhea — fortunately I have already recovered."
translations.idiomatic: One day, after audience in the rear hall, the Emperor said, "I drank too much iced water earlier and suddenly had severe diarrhea — fortunately I have already recovered."

sentences.zh: 」師點曰：「自古人君當無事時，快意所為，忽其所當戒，其後未有不悔者。

translations.literal: Shidian said: "Since antiquity, when a ruler has nothing to do, he does as he pleases and suddenly forgets what he should guard against — afterward there has never been one who did not regret it."
translations.idiomatic: Shidian said, "Since antiquity, when a ruler has nothing to do, he does as he pleases and suddenly forgets what he should guard against. Afterward there has never been one who did not regret it."

sentences.zh: 」上深然之。

translations.literal: The Emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor deeply approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，辭兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he resigned concurrent appointment as Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he resigned concurrent appointment as deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 權提舉國史院，權提舉《國朝會要》。

translations.literal: Acting Commissioner of the National History Office; Acting Commissioner of the National Institutions Compendium.
translations.idiomatic: Acting commissioner of the National History Office; acting commissioner of the National Institutions Compendium.

sentences.zh: 十四年，除知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 師點惓惓搜訪人才，手書置夾袋中，謂蜀去朝廷遠，人才難以自見，蜀士之賢者，俾各疏其所知，差次其才行、文學，每有除授，必列陳之。

translations.literal: Shidian diligently searched out talent, writing names by hand and placing them in a folder; he said Sichuan was far from court and talent was hard to show itself — worthy Sichuan scholars were asked each to list those they knew, ranking their conduct, talent, and literary skill; whenever there was an appointment, he always listed and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Shidian diligently searched out talent, writing names by hand and placing them in a folder. He said Sichuan was far from court and talent was hard to show itself. Worthy Sichuan scholars were asked each to list those they knew, ranking their conduct, talent, and literary skill. Whenever there was an appointment, he always listed and presented them.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，以資政殿大學士知泉州，除提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year, as Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy he was appointed Prefect of Quanzhou; he was appointed Commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year, as grand academician of the Hall of Literary Policy he was appointed prefect of Quanzhou. He was appointed commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，除知隆興府、江西安撫使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxi he was appointed Prefect of Longxing Prefecture and Pacification Commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxi he was appointed prefect of Longxing Prefecture and pacification commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 師點嘗謂諸子曰：「吾平生仕宦，皆任其升沉，初未嘗容心其間，不枉道附麗，獨人主知之，遂至顯用。

translations.literal: Shidian once told his sons: "All my life in office I have let promotion and demotion take their course; from the first I never calculated among them, never bent the Way to attach myself to power — only the ruler knew me, and so I reached prominent employment."
translations.idiomatic: Shidian once told his sons, "All my life in office I have let promotion and demotion take their course. From the first I never calculated among them, never bent the Way to attach myself to power. Only the ruler knew me, and so I reached prominent employment."

sentences.zh: 夫人窮達有命，不在巧圖，惟忠孝乃吾事也。

translations.literal: A man's poverty and success have destiny; it lies not in clever scheming — only loyalty and filial piety are my concern."
translations.idiomatic: A man's poverty and success have destiny. It lies not in clever scheming. Only loyalty and filial piety are my concern."

sentences.zh: 」三年，得疾薨，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the third year he fell ill and died at age sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he fell ill and died at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded grand master of the gold seal and purple ribbon.

sentences.zh: 有奏議七卷、制槁八卷、《東宮講議》五卷、《易說》四卷、《史識》五卷、文集八卷。

translations.literal: He left seven juan of memorials, eight juan of draft edicts, five juan of Eastern Palace Lectures, four juan of Explanations of the Changes, five juan of Historical Judgments, and eight juan of collected writings.
translations.idiomatic: He left seven juan of memorials, eight juan of draft edicts, five juan of Eastern Palace Lectures, four juan of Explanations of the Changes, five juan of Historical Judgments, and eight juan of collected writings.

sentences.zh: 蕭燧，字照鄰，臨江軍人。

translations.literal: Xiao Sui, courtesy name Zhaolin, was a native of Linjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sui, courtesy name Zhaolin, was a native of Linjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高祖固，皇祐初為廣西轉運使，知儂智高凶狡，條上羈縻之策於樞府，不果用，智高後果叛。

translations.literal: His founding ancestor Gu, in the early Huangyou era, was Transport Commissioner of Guangxi; knowing Nong Zhigao was fierce and cunning, he submitted a policy of restraint to the Military Affairs Bureau — it was not adopted, and Zhigao later rebelled as expected.
translations.idiomatic: His founding ancestor Gu, in the early Huangyou era, was transport commissioner of Guangxi. Knowing Nong Zhigao was fierce and cunning, he submitted a policy of restraint to the Military Affairs Bureau. It was not adopted, and Zhigao later rebelled as expected.

sentences.zh: 父增，紹興初嘗應制舉。

translations.literal: His father Zeng in the early Shaoxing era once responded to the special examination.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zeng in the early Shaoxing era once responded to the special examination.

sentences.zh: 燧生而穎異，幼能屬文。

translations.literal: Sui was gifted from birth and could compose essays from childhood.
translations.idiomatic: Sui was gifted from birth and could compose essays from childhood.

sentences.zh: 紹興十八年，擢進士高第。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shaoxing he was selected in the top rank of the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shaoxing he was selected in the top rank of the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授平江府觀察推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed Investigating Officer in Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating officer in Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時秦檜當國，其親黨密告燧，秋試必主文漕臺，燧詰其故，曰：「丞相有子就舉，欲以屬公。

translations.literal: At the time Qin Hui held the state; his close associates secretly told Sui that in the autumn examination he would surely chief the transport commission — Sui asked why; they said: "The Chancellor has a son taking the exam and wishes to entrust it to you."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qin Hui held the state. His close associates secretly told Sui that in the autumn examination he would surely chief the transport commission. Sui asked why. They said, "The chancellor has a son taking the exam and wishes to entrust it to you."

sentences.zh: 」燧怒曰：「初仕敢欺心耶！

translations.literal: Sui angrily said: "At the start of office dare I deceive my heart!"
translations.idiomatic: Sui angrily said, "At the start of office dare I deceive my heart!"

sentences.zh: 」檜懷之，既而被檄秀州，至則員溢，就院易一員往漕闈，秦熺果中前列。

translations.literal: Hui resented him; soon he was dispatched to Xiuzhou — when he arrived the quota was full, so he exchanged one slot at the academy and went to the transport examination; Qin Xi indeed ranked at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Hui resented him. Soon he was dispatched to Xiuzhou. When he arrived the quota was full, so he exchanged one slot at the academy and went to the transport examination. Qin Xi indeed ranked at the front.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，當為學官，避檜，調靜江府察推而歸。

translations.literal: When his term ended he should have become an academic officer; avoiding Hui, he was assigned Investigating Officer in Jingjiang Prefecture and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he should have become an academic officer. Avoiding Hui, he was assigned investigating officer in Jingjiang Prefecture and returned home.

sentences.zh: 燧未第時，夢神人示以文書，記其一聯云：「如火烈烈，玉石俱焚；

translations.literal: Before Sui passed the examination, he dreamed a divine man showed him a document recording one couplet: "Like fire blazing bright, jade and stone burn together;
translations.idiomatic: Before Sui passed the examination, he dreamed a divine man showed him a document recording one couplet: "Like fire blazing bright, jade and stone burn together;

sentences.zh: 在冬青青，松柏不改。

translations.literal: in winter green and fresh, pine and cypress unchanged."
translations.idiomatic: in winter green and fresh, pine and cypress unchanged."

sentences.zh: 」已而果符前事。

translations.literal: Later it indeed matched what had gone before.
translations.idiomatic: Later it indeed matched what had gone before.

sentences.zh: 未幾，丁憂。

translations.literal: Before long he entered mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he entered mourning.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，授靖州教授。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was appointed Professor in Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he was appointed professor in Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 孝宗初，除諸王宮大小學教授。

translations.literal: At the start of Emperor Xiaozong's reign he was appointed Professor in the Princes' Primary and Secondary Schools.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Emperor Xiaozong's reign he was appointed professor in the princes' primary and secondary schools.

sentences.zh: 輪對，論官當擇人，不當為人擇官，上喜，制《用人論》賜大臣。

translations.literal: In a rotating audience he argued that offices should choose men, not that men should choose offices; the Emperor was pleased and composed An Essay on Employing Men to bestow on grand ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In a rotating audience he argued that offices should choose men, not that men should choose offices. The Emperor was pleased and composed An Essay on Employing Men to bestow on grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年，累遷至國子司業兼權起居舍人，進起居郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunxi he was promoted in succession to Vice Director of the Imperial University with concurrent Acting Attendant Drafting Officer, then Attendant Drafting Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunxi he was promoted in succession to vice director of the Imperial University with concurrent acting attendant drafting officer, then attendant drafting officer.

sentences.zh: 先是，察官闕，朝論多屬燧，以未歷縣，遂除左司諫。

translations.literal: Previously the investigating censor post was vacant; court opinion mostly favored Sui, but because he had not yet served in a county he was appointed Left Remonstrating Censor instead.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the investigating censor post was vacant. Court opinion mostly favored Sui, but because he had not yet served in a county he was appointed left remonstrating censor instead.

sentences.zh: 上諭執政：「昨除蕭燧若何？

translations.literal: The Emperor told the executives: "How about yesterday's appointment of Xiao Sui?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told the executives, "How about yesterday's appointment of Xiao Sui?"

sentences.zh: 」龔茂良奏：「燧純實無華，正可任言責，聞除目下，外議甚允。

translations.literal: Gong Maoliang memorialized: "Sui is pure and solid without ornament — exactly fit to bear the duty of speech; hearing the appointment went out, outside opinion is very satisfied."
translations.idiomatic: Gong Maoliang memorialized, "Sui is pure and solid without ornament — exactly fit to bear the duty of speech. Hearing the appointment went out, outside opinion is very satisfied."

sentences.zh: 」燧首論辨邪正然後可以治，上以外臺耳目多不稱職，時宦官甘昪之客胡與可、都承旨王抃之族叔秬皆持節於外，有所依憑，無善狀，燧皆奏罷之。

translations.literal: Sui first argued that distinguishing the wicked from the upright must come before governance can proceed; the Emperor, because many provincial commissioners and censors were unfit, and at the time the eunuch Gan Sheng's client Hu Yuhe and Chief Aide Wang Bian's clansman Jiu both held commissions outside with backing and no good record — Sui memorialized to dismiss them all.
translations.idiomatic: Sui first argued that distinguishing the wicked from the upright must come before governance can proceed. The Emperor, because many provincial commissioners and censors were unfit, and at the time the eunuch Gan Sheng's client Hu Yuhe and chief aide Wang Bian's clansman Jiu both held commissions outside with backing and no good record — Sui memorialized to dismiss them all.

sentences.zh: 時覆議進取，上以問燧，對曰：「今賢否雜揉，風俗澆浮，兵未強，財未裕，宜臥薪嚐膽以圖內治。

translations.literal: At the time recovery was debated again; the Emperor asked Sui, who replied: "Now the worthy and unworthy are mixed, custom is shallow and floating, the army is not yet strong, and finances are not yet ample — one should sleep on brushwood and taste gall to plan internal governance."
translations.idiomatic: At the time recovery was debated again. The Emperor asked Sui, who replied, "Now the worthy and unworthy are mixed, custom is shallow and floating, the army is not yet strong, and finances are not yet ample. One should sleep on brushwood and taste gall to plan internal governance."

sentences.zh: 若恃小康，萌驕心，非臣所知。

translations.literal: If one relies on modest prosperity and nurtures arrogance, that is not what your servant knows."
translations.idiomatic: If one relies on modest prosperity and nurtures arrogance, that is not what your servant knows."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「忠言也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Loyal words."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Loyal words."

sentences.zh: 」因勸上正紀綱；

translations.literal: He thereupon urged the Emperor to rectify discipline;
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon urged the Emperor to rectify discipline;

sentences.zh: 容直言；

translations.literal: tolerate straight speech;
translations.idiomatic: tolerate straight speech;

sentences.zh: 親君子，遠小人；

translations.literal: draw near to gentlemen and keep petty men at a distance;
translations.idiomatic: draw near to gentlemen and keep petty men at a distance;

sentences.zh: 近習有勞可賞以祿，不可假以權。

translations.literal: close attendants who have merit may be rewarded with stipends but must not be lent power.
translations.idiomatic: close attendants who have merit may be rewarded with stipends but must not be lent power.

sentences.zh: 上皆嘉納。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved all.

sentences.zh: 擢右諫議大夫，入謝，上曰：「卿議論鯁切，不求名譽，糾正姦邪，不恤仇怨。」

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Remonstrating Censor; entering to give thanks, the Emperor said: "Your remonstrances are cutting and do not seek reputation; you correct wickedness and do not spare enmity."
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right remonstrating censor. Entering to give thanks, the Emperor said, "Your remonstrances are cutting and do not seek reputation. You correct wickedness and do not spare enmity."

sentences.zh: 五年，同知貢舉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he served as Deputy Director of the Examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he served as deputy director of the examinations.

sentences.zh: 有旨下江東西、湖南北帥司招軍，燧言：「所募多市井年少，利犒齎，往往捕農民以應數，取細民以充軍。

translations.literal: There was an order to the Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Hubei commanders to recruit soldiers; Sui said: "Those recruited are mostly young men of the marketplace who want bounty pay; they often seize farmers to fill quotas and take common people to fill the army."
translations.idiomatic: There was an order to the Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Hubei commanders to recruit soldiers. Sui said, "Those recruited are mostly young men of the marketplace who want bounty pay. They often seize farmers to fill quotas and take common people to fill the army."

sentences.zh: 乞嚴戒諸郡，庶得丁壯以為用。

translations.literal: I beg strict warning to all prefectures so that strong young men may be put to use."
translations.idiomatic: I beg strict warning to all prefectures so that strong young men may be put to use."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was followed.

sentences.zh: 夔帥李景孠貪虐，參政趙雄庇之，臺臣謝廓然不敢論，燧獨奏罷之。

translations.literal: The Kuizhou commander Li Jingsun was greedy and cruel; Vice Grand Councilor Zhao Xiong shielded him; censor Xie Kuoran dared not speak; Sui alone memorialized for his dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhou commander Li Jingsun was greedy and cruel. Vice grand councilor Zhao Xiong shielded him. Censor Xie Kuoran dared not speak. Sui alone memorialized for his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 雄果營救，覆命還任。

translations.literal: Xiong indeed worked for his rescue; a reversed order restored him to office.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong indeed worked for his rescue. A reversed order restored him to office.

sentences.zh: 燧再論，並及雄。

translations.literal: Sui remonstrated again, implicating Xiong as well.
translations.idiomatic: Sui remonstrated again, implicating Xiong as well.

sentences.zh: 雄密奏燧誤聽景孠仇人之言，遂下臨安府捕恭州士人鐘京等置之獄，坐以罪，景孠復依舊職。

translations.literal: Xiong secretly memorialized that Sui had wrongly heard the words of Jingsun's enemy; the Lin'an Prefecture was then ordered to arrest Gongzhou scholar Zhong Jing and others and put them in prison, convicting them; Jingsun resumed his old post.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong secretly memorialized that Sui had wrongly heard the words of Jingsun's enemy. The Lin'an Prefecture was then ordered to arrest Gongzhou scholar Zhong Jing and others and put them in prison, convicting them. Jingsun resumed his old post.

sentences.zh: 燧乃自劾，詔以風聞不許，竟力求去。

translations.literal: Sui then impeached himself; an edict said rumor was not permitted — he still forcefully begged to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Sui then impeached himself. An edict said rumor was not permitted — he still forcefully begged to leave.

sentences.zh: 徙刑部侍郎，不拜，固請補外。

translations.literal: Transferred to Vice Minister of Justice, he did not accept and forcefully begged for an outside post.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to vice minister of justice, he did not accept and forcefully begged for an outside post.

sentences.zh: 出知嚴州，吏部尚書鄭丙、侍郎李椿上疏留之，上亦尋悔。

translations.literal: Sent out as Prefect of Yanzhou, Minister of Personnel Zheng Bing and Vice Minister Li Chun memorialized to retain him; the Emperor also soon regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as prefect of Yanzhou, minister of personnel Zheng Bing and vice minister Li Chun memorialized to retain him. The Emperor also soon regretted it.

sentences.zh: 嚴地狹財匱，始至，官鏹不滿三千，燧儉以足用。

translations.literal: Yan was narrow in territory and poor in resources; when he first arrived, official funds were less than three thousand; Sui lived frugally and made them suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was narrow in territory and poor in resources. When he first arrived, official funds were less than three thousand. Sui lived frugally and made them suffice.

sentences.zh: 二年之間，積至十五萬，以其羨補積逋，諸邑皆寬。

translations.literal: Within two years he accumulated one hundred fifty thousand, using the surplus to cover accumulated arrears — all districts were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Within two years he accumulated one hundred fifty thousand, using the surplus to cover accumulated arrears. All districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 先是，宣和庚子方臘盜起，甲子一周，人人憂懼，會遂安令朘土兵廩給，群言恟恟。

translations.literal: Previously, in the gengzi year of Xuanhe Fang La's rebellion had risen; a jiazi cycle had completed and everyone was fearful; when the Suian magistrate cut local militia rations, talk grew clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the gengzi year of Xuanhe Fang La's rebellion had risen. A jiazi cycle had completed and everyone was fearful. When the Suian magistrate cut local militia rations, talk grew clamorous.

sentences.zh: 燧急易令，且呼卒長告戒，悉畏服。

translations.literal: Sui urgently replaced the magistrate and summoned squad leaders to admonish them — all feared and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sui urgently replaced the magistrate and summoned squad leaders to admonish them. All feared and submitted.

sentences.zh: 城中惡少群擾市，燧密籍姓名，涅補軍額，人以按堵。

translations.literal: Ruffians in the city disturbed the market in groups; Sui secretly registered names and branded them into military quotas — people lived in settled peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ruffians in the city disturbed the market in groups. Sui secretly registered names and branded them into military quotas. People lived in settled peace.

sentences.zh: 上方靳職名，非功不予，詔燧治郡有勞，除敷文閣待制，移知婺州。

translations.literal: The Emperor was then sparing with honorary titles and granted them only for merit; an edict said Sui's governance of the prefecture had merit and appointed him Awaiting Orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, transferring him to Prefect of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was then sparing with honorary titles and granted them only for merit. An edict said Sui's governance of the prefecture had merit and appointed him awaiting orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, transferring him to prefect of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 父老遮道，幾不得行，送出境者以千數。

translations.literal: Elders blocked the road — he could hardly leave; those who saw him off beyond the border numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Elders blocked the road — he could hardly leave. Those who saw him off beyond the border numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 婺與嚴鄰，人熟知條教，不勞而治。

translations.literal: Wu bordered Yan; people knew the regulations well and it was governed without effort.
translations.idiomatic: Wu bordered Yan. People knew the regulations well and it was governed without effort.

sentences.zh: 歲旱，浙西常平司請移粟于嚴，燧謂：「東西異路，不當與，然安忍於舊治坐視？

translations.literal: In a year of drought, the Western Zhejiang Ever-Normal Granary requested grain moved to Yan; Sui said: "East and west are different routes and should not be supplied — yet how can I bear to sit in my old jurisdiction and watch?"
translations.idiomatic: In a year of drought, the Western Zhejiang Ever-Normal Granary requested grain moved to Yan. Sui said, "East and west are different routes and should not be supplied — yet how can I bear to sit in my old jurisdiction and watch?"

sentences.zh: 」為請諸朝，發太倉米振之。

translations.literal: " He requested it of the court and had Taicang grain sent to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: He requested it of the court and had Taicang grain sent to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 八年，召還，言：「江、浙再歲水旱，願下詔求言，仍令諸司通融郡縣財賦，毋但督迫。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was recalled and said: "Jiang and Zhe have suffered flood and drought two years running; I pray an edict seek remonstrance, and also order all offices to coordinate prefectural finances flexibly — do not merely press for collection."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was recalled and said, "Jiang and Zhe have suffered flood and drought two years running. I pray an edict seek remonstrance, and also order all offices to coordinate prefectural finances flexibly — do not merely press for collection."

sentences.zh: 」除吏部右選侍郎，旋兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Vice Minister of the Right Selection Bureau of Personnel, and soon also Chancellor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of the right selection bureau of personnel, and soon also chancellor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 九年，為樞密都承旨。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was Chief Aide to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was chief aide to the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 近例，承旨以知閤門官兼，或怙寵招權，上思復用儒臣，故命燧以龍圖閣待制為之。

translations.literal: By recent precedent the chief aide was held concurrently by a court-attendant gate officer; some relied on favor to grasp power. The Emperor wished to restore use of Confucian officials and therefore appointed Sui, as Awaiting Orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, to the post.
translations.idiomatic: By recent precedent the chief aide was held concurrently by a court-attendant gate officer. Some relied on favor to grasp power. The Emperor wished to restore use of Confucian officials and therefore appointed Sui, as awaiting orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, to the post.

sentences.zh: 燧言：「債帥之風未殄，群臣多迎合獻諛，強辨干譽，宜察其虛實。

translations.literal: Sui said: "The wind of debt-commanders has not yet died out; many ministers cater and offer flattery, arguing forcefully for reputation — their reality and pretense should be examined."
translations.idiomatic: Sui said, "The wind of debt-commanders has not yet died out. Many ministers cater and offer flattery, arguing forcefully for reputation. Their reality and pretense should be examined."

sentences.zh: 」上稱善。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 除權刑部尚書，充金使館伴。

translations.literal: He was appointed Acting Minister of Justice and served as escort for the Jurchen envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting minister of justice and served as escort for the Jurchen envoy.

sentences.zh: 十年，兼權吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he also held concurrent appointment as Acting Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he also held concurrent appointment as acting minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 上言廣西諸郡民身丁錢之弊。

translations.literal: He memorialized on the abuse of the personal service tax in Guangxi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on the abuse of the personal service tax in Guangxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 兼侍講，升侍讀。

translations.literal: Concurrent Reader; promoted to Senior Reader.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrent reader; promoted to senior reader.

sentences.zh: 言：「命令不可數易，憲章不可數改。

translations.literal: He said: "Commands must not be changed frequently; statutes must not be revised repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: He said, "Commands must not be changed frequently. Statutes must not be revised repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 初官不許恩例免試，今或竟令注授。

translations.literal: Initially, initial appointees were not permitted hereditary exemption from examination — now some are directly registered and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, initial appointees were not permitted hereditary exemption from examination — now some are directly registered and appointed.

sentences.zh: 既卻羨餘之數，今反以出剩為名。

translations.literal: Surplus was once rejected — now surplus is named as output.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus was once rejected — now surplus is named as output.

sentences.zh: 諸路錄大辟，長吏當親詰，若死囚數多，宜如漢制殿最以聞。

translations.literal: All routes record capital cases; chief officials should personally examine — if condemned prisoners are numerous, ranking by achievement as in Han practice should be reported.
translations.idiomatic: All routes record capital cases. Chief officials should personally examine — if condemned prisoners are numerous, ranking by achievement as in Han practice should be reported.

translations.literal: " Many matters were implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Many matters were implemented.

sentences.zh: 慶典霈澤，丁錢減半，亦自燧發之。

translations.literal: At the celebration amnesty the personal service tax was halved — this too originated with Sui.
translations.idiomatic: At the celebration amnesty the personal service tax was halved — this too originated with Sui.

sentences.zh: 高宗山陵，充按行使，除參知政事，尋充永思陵禮儀使，權監修國史日曆。

translations.literal: At Emperor Gaozong's mountain tomb he served as inspection envoy; appointed Vice Grand Councilor; soon also Ritual Commissioner for the Eternal Reflection Tomb, Acting Supervisor of the National History Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: At Emperor Gaozong's mountain tomb he served as inspection envoy. Appointed vice grand councilor. Soon also ritual commissioner for the Eternal Reflection Tomb, acting supervisor of the national history calendar.

sentences.zh: 十六年，權知樞密院。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was Acting Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以年及自陳，上留之，不可，除資政殿學士，與郡。

translations.literal: Citing age he offered himself; the Emperor kept him — not permitted — and appointed him Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy with a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Citing age he offered himself. The Emperor kept him — not permitted — and appointed him grand academician of the Hall of Literary Policy with a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復請閑，提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: He again begged leisure and was made Commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again begged leisure and was made commissioner of the Tongsiao Palace in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxi he died at age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxi he died at the age of seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 諡「正肅」。

translations.literal: Posthumous title "Zhengsu."
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous title "Zhengsu."

sentences.zh: 孝宗每稱其全護善類，誠實不欺，手書《二十八將傳》以賜。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong often praised his full protection of the good and honest lack of deception, and hand-wrote the Biographies of the Twenty-Eight Generals to bestow on him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong often praised his full protection of the good and honest lack of deception, and hand-wrote the Biographies of the Twenty-Eight Generals to bestow on him.

sentences.zh: 子逵，登淳熙十四年進士第，唱名第四，孝宗曰：「逵才氣甚佳，父子高科，殊可喜。

translations.literal: His son Kui passed the jinshi in the fourteenth year of Chunxi, ranked fourth at the announcement — Emperor Xiaozong said: "Kui's talent is excellent; father and son both high graduates — very delightful."
translations.idiomatic: His son Kui passed the jinshi in the fourteenth year of Chunxi, ranked fourth at the announcement. Emperor Xiaozong said, "Kui's talent is excellent. Father and son both high graduates — very delightful."

sentences.zh: 」逵累官至太常。

translations.literal: " Kui rose in succession to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Kui rose in succession to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 龔茂良

translations.literal: Gong Maoliang
translations.idiomatic: Gong Maoliang

sentences.zh: 龔茂良，字實之，興化軍人。

translations.idiomatic: Gong Maoliang, courtesy name Shizhi, was a native of Xinghua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹興八年，進士第。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shaoxing he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 為南安簿、邵武司法。

translations.literal: He served as Registrar in Nan'an and Judicial Officer in Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as registrar in Nan'an and judicial officer in Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 父母喪，哀號擗踴，鄰不忍聞。

translations.literal: When his parents died he wailed and beat his breast; neighbors could not bear to hear.
translations.idiomatic: When his parents died he wailed and beat his breast. Neighbors could not bear to hear.

sentences.zh: 調泉州察推，以廉勤稱。

translations.literal: Assigned Investigating Officer in Quanzhou — known for integrity and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned investigating officer in Quanzhou — known for integrity and diligence.

sentences.zh: 改宣教郎，以同知樞密院事黃祖舜薦，召試館職，除秘書省正字。

translations.literal: Changed to Instructor; recommended by Deputy Director of Military Affairs Huang Zushun; summoned to test for institute post; appointed Corrector in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to instructor. Recommended by deputy director of military affairs Huang Zushun. Summoned to test for institute post. Appointed corrector in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部郎官。

translations.literal: Promoted in succession to Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted in succession to director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 張浚視師江、淮，茂良言：「本朝禦敵，景德之勝本於能斷，靖康之禍在於致疑，願仰法景德之斷，勿為靖康之疑。

translations.literal: When Zhang Jun took command on the Jiang-Huai front, Maoliang said: "Our dynasty's defense against the enemy — the victory at Jingde rested on being able to decide; the disaster at Jingkang lay in breeding doubt. I pray emulate Jingde's decisiveness and not Jingkang's doubt."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Jun took command on the Jiang-Huai front, Maoliang said, "Our dynasty's defense against the enemy — the victory at Jingde rested on being able to decide; the disaster at Jingkang lay in breeding doubt. translations.literal: " Appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed investigating censor.

translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Zhe suffered great flood. An edict sought omissions and faults. Maoliang memorialized, "Water is utmost yin. Its omen is favor to women, flattery, and petty men's exclusive power."

sentences.zh: 崇、觀、政和，小人道長，內則憸腐竊弄，外則姦回充斥，於是京城大水，以至金人犯闕。

translations.literal: In the Chong, Guan, and Zhenghe eras petty men's way grew long — within, sycophants stole and manipulated; without, wicked men filled the realm — then the capital flooded, even to the Jurchens violating the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chong, Guan, and Zhenghe eras petty men's way grew long. Within, sycophants stole and manipulated; without, wicked men filled the realm. Then the capital flooded, even to the Jurchens violating the capital.

sentences.zh: 今進退一人，施行一事，命由中出，人心譁然，指為此輩。

translations.literal: Now promoting or demoting one man, implementing one affair — orders come from within; hearts clamor, pointing at this crowd.
translations.idiomatic: Now promoting or demoting one man, implementing one affair — orders come from within. Hearts clamor, pointing at this crowd.

sentences.zh: 臣願先去腹心之疾，然後政事闕失可次第言矣。

translations.literal: Your servant prays first remove the sickness at the heart — then omissions in government may be spoken in order."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant prays first remove the sickness at the heart — then omissions in government may be spoken in order."

sentences.zh: 」內侍梁珂、曾覿、龍大淵皆用事，故茂良及之。

translations.literal: The eunuchs Liang Ke, Zeng Di, and Long Dayuan all held power — hence Maoliang touched on them.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs Liang Ke, Zeng Di, and Long Dayuan all held power — hence Maoliang touched on them.

sentences.zh: 遷右正言。

translations.literal: Promoted to Right Remonstrating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to right remonstrating censor.

sentences.zh: 會內侍李珂沒，贈節度，諡「靖恭」，茂良諫曰：「中興名相如趙鼎，勳臣如韓世忠，皆未有諡，如朝廷舉行，亦足少慰忠義之心。

translations.literal: When the eunuch Li Ke died, he was posthumously granted military commissioner and posthumous title "Jinggong"; Maoliang remonstrated: "Famous ministers of the Restoration like Zhao Ding, meritorious ministers like Han Shizhong, have never had posthumous titles — if the court carried this out, it would somewhat comfort loyal hearts.
translations.idiomatic: When the eunuch Li Ke died, he was posthumously granted military commissioner and posthumous title "Jinggong." Maoliang remonstrated, "Famous ministers of the Restoration like Zhao Ding, meritorious ministers like Han Shizhong, have never had posthumous titles. sentences.zh: 今施於珂為可惜。

translations.literal: To grant it to Ke is regrettable."
translations.idiomatic: To grant it to Ke is regrettable."

sentences.zh: 」竟寢其諡。

translations.literal: The posthumous title was finally halted.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title was finally halted.

sentences.zh: 嘗論大淵、覿奸姦，至是又極言之，曰：「今積陰弗解，淫雨益甚，熒惑入斗，正當吳分，天意若有所怒而未釋。

translations.literal: He once argued Dayuan and Di were wicked — now he spoke of them extremely, saying: "Yin accumulates and is not released; excessive rain grows worse; the Spark Star enters the Dipper — right in Wu's portion. Heaven's intent seems angry and not yet appeased.
translations.idiomatic: He once argued Dayuan and Di were wicked — now he spoke of them extremely, saying, "Yin accumulates and is not released. Excessive rain grows worse. The Spark Star enters the Dipper — right in Wu's portion. Heaven's intent seems angry and not yet appeased.

sentences.zh: 二人害政，甚珂百倍。

translations.literal: These two harm government — a hundred times worse than Ke."
translations.idiomatic: These two harm government — a hundred times worse than Ke."

sentences.zh: 」上諭以皆潛邸舊，非他近習比，且俱有文學，敢諫爭，未嘗預外事。

translations.literal: The Emperor explained that both were old companions of the hidden palace, not like other close attendants — both had literary skill, dared remonstrate, and never meddled in outside affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor explained that both were old companions of the hidden palace, not like other close attendants. Both had literary skill, dared remonstrate, and never meddled in outside affairs.

sentences.zh: 翌日，再疏言：「唐德宗謂李泌：『人言盧杞姦邪，朕獨不知，何耶？

translations.literal: The next day he again memorialized: "Tang Dezong said to Li Mi: 'Men say Lu Qi is wicked — I alone do not know it. Why?'
translations.idiomatic: The next day he again memorialized, "Tang Dezong said to Li Mi, 'Men say Lu Qi is wicked — I alone do not know it. Why?'

sentences.zh: 』泌曰：『此其所以為奸邪也。

translations.literal: ' Mi said: 'That is why he is wicked.'"
translations.idiomatic: Mi said, 'That is why he is wicked.'

sentences.zh: 』今大淵、覿所為，行道之人能言之，而陛下更頌其賢，此臣所以深憂。

translations.literal: ' What Dayuan and Di do, travelers can speak of — yet Your Majesty further praises their worth. That is why your servant is deeply worried."
translations.idiomatic: What Dayuan and Di do, travelers can speak of — yet Your Majesty further praises their worth. That is why your servant is deeply worried."

sentences.zh: 」疏入，不報，即家居待罪。

translations.literal: The memorial entered — no response — and he stayed home awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial entered — no response — and he stayed home awaiting punishment.

sentences.zh: 章再上，除太常少卿，五辭不拜，除直秘閣、知建寧府。

translations.literal: Memorial again — appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; five times he declined — appointed Direct Access to the Secret Archive as Prefect of Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Memorial again — appointed vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. Five times he declined — appointed direct access to the Secret Archive as prefect of Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自以不為群小所容，請祠，不允。

translations.literal: Thinking himself not tolerated by the petty crowd, he begged a sinecure — not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking himself not tolerated by the petty crowd, he begged a sinecure — not permitted.

sentences.zh: 上後知二人之姦，既逐於外，起茂良廣東提刑，就知信州。

translations.literal: The Emperor later learned of the two men's wickedness; once they were driven outside, Maoliang was raised as Fiscal Intendant of Guangdong and immediately appointed Prefect of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor later learned of the two men's wickedness. Once they were driven outside, Maoliang was raised as fiscal intendant of Guangdong and immediately appointed prefect of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 即番山之址建學，又置番禺南海縣學，既成，釋奠，行鄉飲酒以落之。

translations.literal: On Fan Mountain's site he built a school, and also established schools in Panyu and Nanhai counties; when complete he performed the sacrifice and held a district drinking ceremony to mark completion.
translations.idiomatic: On Fan Mountain's site he built a school, and also established schools in Panyu and Nanhai counties. When complete he performed the sacrifice and held a district drinking ceremony to mark completion.

sentences.zh: 城東舊有廣惠庵，中原衣冠沒于南者葬之，歲久廢，茂良訪故地，更建海會浮圖，菆寄暴露者皆揜藏無遺。

translations.literal: East of the city was the old Guanghui Abbey where Central Plains gentry who died in the south were buried — long abandoned; Maoliang sought the old site, rebuilt the Sea Assembly pagoda, and all exposed bones were buried without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: East of the city was the old Guanghui Abbey where Central Plains gentry who died in the south were buried — long abandoned. Maoliang sought the old site, rebuilt the Sea Assembly pagoda, and all exposed bones were buried without remainder.

sentences.zh: 召對崇政殿，左丞相陳俊卿欲留之，右相虞允文不樂。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience in the Chongzheng Hall; Left Grand Councilor Chen Junqing wished to retain him; Right Councilor Yu Yunwen was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience in the Chongzheng Hall. Left grand councilor Chen Junqing wished to retain him. Right councilor Yu Yunwen was displeased.

sentences.zh: 會俊卿亦罷，除直顯謨閣、江西運判兼知隆興府。

translations.literal: When Junqing was also dismissed, he was appointed Direct Access to the Xianmo Hall, Jiangxi Transport Commissioner concurrently Prefect of Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Junqing was also dismissed, he was appointed direct access to the Xianmo Hall, Jiangxi transport commissioner concurrently prefect of Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上以江西連歲大旱，知茂良精忠，以一路荒政付之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Jiangxi had suffered drought several years running, knowing Maoliang's deep loyalty, entrusted famine relief for the whole route to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, because Jiangxi had suffered drought several years running, knowing Maoliang's deep loyalty, entrusted famine relief for the whole route to him.

sentences.zh: 茂良戒郡縣免積稅，上戶止索逋，發廩振贍。

translations.literal: Maoliang warned prefectures to waive accumulated taxes, taking only arrears from upper households and opening granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang warned prefectures to waive accumulated taxes, taking only arrears from upper households and opening granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 以右文殿修撰再任，疫癘大作，命醫治療，全活數百萬。

translations.literal: As Compiler in the Hall of Literary Glory he served a second term; epidemic raged — he ordered medical treatment and saved millions.
translations.idiomatic: As compiler in the Hall of Literary Glory he served a second term. Epidemic raged — he ordered medical treatment and saved millions.

sentences.zh: 進待制敷文閣，賞其救荒之功。

translations.literal: Promoted Awaiting Orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, rewarding his famine-relief merit.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted awaiting orders in the Hall for Spreading Culture, rewarding his famine-relief merit.

sentences.zh: 召對，奏：「潢池弄兵之盜，即南畝負耒之民。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he memorialized: "Robbers who play with weapons in the pond are the same southern-field men who shoulder hoes."
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience, he memorialized, "Robbers who play with weapons in the pond are the same southern-field men who shoulder hoes."

sentences.zh: 今諸郡荒田極多，願詔監司守臣條陳，募人從便請耕，民有餘粟，雖驅之為寇，亦不從矣。

translations.literal: Now wasteland in prefectures is extremely abundant — I pray an edict to supervisors and prefects to list proposals, recruiting people to request cultivation as convenient — if people have surplus grain, though driven to banditry they will not follow."
translations.idiomatic: Now wasteland in prefectures is extremely abundant. I pray an edict to supervisors and prefects to list proposals, recruiting people to request cultivation as convenient. If people have surplus grain, though driven to banditry they will not follow."

sentences.zh: 」除禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: " Appointed Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 上亟用茂良，手詔問國朝典故有自從官徑除執政例，明日即拜參知政事。

translations.literal: The Emperor urgently employed Maoliang; a handwritten edict asked whether there was precedent for promoting an attendant directly to executive — the next day he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor urgently employed Maoliang. A handwritten edict asked whether there was precedent for promoting an attendant directly to executive — the next day he was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 奏事，賜坐，上顧葉衡及茂良曰：「兩參政皆公議所與。

translations.literal: Memorializing affairs, he was granted a seat; the Emperor looked at Ye Heng and Maoliang and said: "Both vice councilors are what public opinion gives."
translations.idiomatic: Memorializing affairs, he was granted a seat. The Emperor looked at Ye Heng and Maoliang and said, "Both vice councilors are what public opinion gives."

sentences.zh: 」衡等起謝，上從容曰：「自今諸事毋循私，若鄉曲親戚，且未須援引。

translations.literal: Heng and others rose to give thanks; the Emperor said calmly: "From now on in all matters do not follow private ties — if hometown kin, do not yet recommend them.
translations.idiomatic: Heng and others rose to give thanks. The Emperor said calmly, "From now on in all matters do not follow private ties. If hometown kin, do not yet recommend them.

sentences.zh: 朕每存公道，設有誤，卿等宜力爭，君臣之間不可事形跡。

translations.literal: I always preserve public principle — if there is error, you should forcefully contend; between ruler and minister one must not let conduct show on the surface."
translations.idiomatic: I always preserve public principle. If there is error, you should forcefully contend. Between ruler and minister one must not let conduct show on the surface."

sentences.zh: 」茂良曰：「大臣以道事君，遇有不可，自當啟沃，豈容跡見於外。

translations.literal: Maoliang said: "Grand ministers serve the ruler with the Way — when there is what cannot be done, they should naturally counsel — how can conduct appear on the outside?"
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang said, "Grand ministers serve the ruler with the Way. When there is what cannot be done, they should naturally counsel. How can conduct appear on the outside?"

sentences.zh: 」請詔有司刊定七司法。

translations.literal: " He begged an edict to the responsible offices to compile and fix the seven-branch code.
translations.idiomatic: He begged an edict to the responsible offices to compile and fix the seven-branch code.

sentences.zh: 淮南旱，茂良奏取封樁米十四萬，委漕帥振濟。

translations.literal: Huainan suffered drought; Maoliang memorialized to take 140,000 piculs of sealed reserve grain and entrust the transport commissioner for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan suffered drought. Maoliang memorialized to take 140,000 piculs of sealed reserve grain and entrust the transport commissioner for relief.

sentences.zh: 或謂：「救荒常平事，今遽取封樁米，毋乃不可？

translations.literal: Some said: "Famine relief is Ever-Normal Granary business — to suddenly take sealed reserve grain, is it not impermissible?"
translations.idiomatic: Some said, "Famine relief is Ever-Normal Granary business — to suddenly take sealed reserve grain, is it not impermissible?"

sentences.zh: 」茂良以為：「淮南咫尺敵境，民久未復業，饑寒所逼，萬一嘯聚，患害立見，寧能計此米乎？

translations.literal: Maoliang thought: "Huainan is a stone's throw from the enemy border; the people long unre settled, driven by hunger and cold — if they gather with a shout, harm appears at once. Can one count this grain?"
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang thought, "Huainan is a stone's throw from the enemy border. The people long unsettled, driven by hunger and cold — if they gather with a shout, harm appears at once. Can one count this grain?"

sentences.zh: 」他日，上獎諭曰：「淮南旱荒，民無饑色，卿之力也。」

translations.literal: " Another day the Emperor praised him: "Huainan drought and wasteland — the people show no hunger — your strength."
translations.idiomatic: Another day the Emperor praised him, "Huainan drought and wasteland — the people show no hunger — your strength."

sentences.zh: 潮州守奏通判不法，得旨，下帥臣體訪。

translations.literal: The Chaozhou prefect memorialized that the vice prefect acted unlawfully; an order was received for the route commander to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The Chaozhou prefect memorialized that the vice prefect acted unlawfully. An order was received for the route commander to investigate.

sentences.zh: 通判，茂良鄉人也，同列密以省吏付棘寺推鞫，欲及茂良。

translations.literal: The vice prefect was Maoliang's townsman; colleagues secretly gave the provincial clerk to the prison for interrogation, intending to implicate Maoliang.
translations.idiomatic: The vice prefect was Maoliang's townsman. Colleagues secretly gave the provincial clerk to the prison for interrogation, intending to implicate Maoliang.

sentences.zh: 奏事退，同列留身，出獄案進上，茂良不知也。

translations.literal: After memorializing he withdrew; colleagues remained and produced the prison case to the Emperor — Maoliang did not know.
translations.idiomatic: After memorializing he withdrew. Colleagues remained and produced the prison case to the Emperor — Maoliang did not know.

sentences.zh: 上厲聲曰：「參政決無此！

translations.literal: The Emperor said sternly: "The vice councilor absolutely did not do this!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said sternly, "The vice councilor absolutely did not do this!"

sentences.zh: 」茂良遜謝，不復辯。

translations.literal: Maoliang declined with thanks and did not argue further.
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang declined with thanks and did not argue further.

sentences.zh: 葉衡罷，上命茂良以首參行相事。

translations.literal: When Ye Heng was dismissed, the Emperor ordered Maoliang as senior vice councilor to act as grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: When Ye Heng was dismissed, the Emperor ordered Maoliang as senior vice councilor to act as grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 慶壽禮行，中外覬恩，茂良慨然歎曰：「此當以身任怨，不敢愛身以弊天下。

translations.literal: When the Celebration of Longevity rites were performed, inside and outside hoped for grace; Maoliang sighed and said: "This should be borne with one's body, resenting blame — one must not spare the body and harm the empire.
translations.idiomatic: When the Celebration of Longevity rites were performed, inside and outside hoped for grace. Maoliang sighed and said, "This should be borne with one's body, resenting blame. One must not spare the body and harm the empire.

sentences.zh: 若自一命以上覃轉，不知月添給奉與來歲郊恩奏補幾何，將何以給？」

translations.literal: If from first rank upward all receive broad promotion — who knows how much monthly stipend and next year's suburban grace and supplemental appointments will cost? How will it be supplied?"
translations.idiomatic: If from first rank upward all receive broad promotion — who knows how much monthly stipend and next year's suburban grace and supplemental appointments will cost? How will it be supplied?"

sentences.zh: 宣諭獎用廉退，茂良奏：「朱熹操行耿介，屢召不起，宜蒙錄用。

translations.literal: Imperial instruction praised use of the honest and retiring; Maoliang memorialized: "Zhu Xi's conduct is upright; repeatedly summoned he did not come — he should be recorded and employed."
translations.idiomatic: Imperial instruction praised use of the honest and retiring. Maoliang memorialized, "Zhu Xi's conduct is upright. Repeatedly summoned he did not come — he should be recorded and employed."

sentences.zh: 」除秘書郎。

translations.literal: " Appointed Secretary Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed secretary gentleman.

sentences.zh: 群小乘間讒毀，未幾，手詔付茂良，謂「虛名之士，恐壞朝廷」，熹迄不至。

translations.literal: Petty men seized the interval to slander; before long a handwritten edict was given Maoliang saying "men of empty reputation may harm the court" — Xi never came.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men seized the interval to slander. Before long a handwritten edict was given Maoliang saying "men of empty reputation may harm the court" — Xi never came.

sentences.zh: 錢良臣侵盜大軍錢糧，累數十萬，茂良奏其事，手詔令具析。

translations.literal: Qian Liangchen embezzled several hundred thousand in army funds and grain; Maoliang memorialized the matter; a handwritten edict ordered detailed analysis.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liangchen embezzled several hundred thousand in army funds and grain. Maoliang memorialized the matter. A handwritten edict ordered detailed analysis.

sentences.zh: 俄召良臣赴闕，駸駸柄用，其後茂良之貶，良臣與有力焉。

translations.literal: Soon Liangchen was summoned to court and gradually wielded power — afterward Maoliang's demotion had Liangchen's force behind it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liangchen was summoned to court and gradually wielded power. Afterward Maoliang's demotion had Liangchen's force behind it.

sentences.zh: 茂良之以首參行相事也，逾再歲，上亦不置相，因諭茂良：「史官近奏三台星不明，蓋實艱其選耳。

translations.literal: When Maoliang acted as grand councilor as senior vice councilor, after more than two years the Emperor still did not appoint a grand councilor and therefore told Maoliang: "Historians recently memorialized that the Three Platforms stars are dim — it truly makes selection difficult."
translations.idiomatic: When Maoliang acted as grand councilor as senior vice councilor, after more than two years the Emperor still did not appoint a grand councilor and therefore told Maoliang, "Historians recently memorialized that the Three Platforms stars are dim — it truly makes selection difficult."

sentences.zh: 」淳熙四年正月，召史浩於四明，茂良亦覺眷衰，因疾力求去。

translations.literal: " In the first month of the fourth year of Chunxi, Shi Hao was summoned from Siming; Maoliang also felt favor waning and forcefully begged to leave on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Chunxi, Shi Hao was summoned from Siming. Maoliang also felt favor waning and forcefully begged to leave on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕以經筵召史浩，卿不須疑。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I summoned Shi Hao for the classics lecture — you need not doubt."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I summoned Shi Hao for the classics lecture — you need not doubt."

sentences.zh: 時曾覿欲以文資祿其孫，茂良以文武官各隨本色蔭補格法繳進。

translations.literal: At the time Zeng Di wished to grant his grandson a civil stipend; Maoliang returned the memorial on the hereditary privilege grid for civil and military offices each following their original category.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zeng Di wished to grant his grandson a civil stipend. Maoliang returned the memorial on the hereditary privilege grid for civil and military offices each following their original category.

sentences.zh: 覿因茂良入堂道間，俾直省官賈光祖等當道不避。

translations.literal: Di, as Maoliang entered the hall corridor, had direct-access officials Jia Guangzu and others block the way without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Di, as Maoliang entered the hall corridor, had direct-access officials Jia Guangzu and others block the way without yielding.

sentences.zh: 街司叱之，曰：「參政能幾時！

translations.literal: The street office shouted at them; they said: "How long will the vice councilor last!"
translations.idiomatic: The street office shouted at them. They said, "How long will the vice councilor last!"

sentences.zh: 」茂良奏：「臣固不足道，所惜者朝廷大體。

translations.literal: Maoliang memorialized: "Your servant is indeed not worth speaking of — what is regretted is the larger pattern of the court."
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang memorialized, "Your servant is indeed not worth speaking of — what is regretted is the larger pattern of the court."

sentences.zh: 」上諭覿往謝，茂良正色曰：「參知政事者，朝廷參知政事也。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Di to go apologize; Maoliang said sternly: "Vice grand councilor — the court's vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed Di to go apologize. Maoliang said sternly, "Vice grand councilor — the court's vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 」覿慚退。

translations.literal: " Di withdrew ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Di withdrew ashamed.

sentences.zh: 上諭茂良先遣人於覿，衝替而後施行。

translations.literal: The Emperor told Maoliang first to send men to Di, replace them, and then implement.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told Maoliang first to send men to Di, replace them, and then implement.

sentences.zh: 茂良批旨，取賈光祖輩下臨安府撻之。

translations.literal: Maoliang annotated the order: take Jia Guangzu and the rest to Lin'an Prefecture for beating.
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang annotated the order: take Jia Guangzu and the rest to Lin'an Prefecture for beating.

sentences.zh: 手詔宣問施行太遽，茂良待罪。

translations.literal: A handwritten edict said the implementation was too hasty; Maoliang awaited punishment.
translations.idiomatic: A handwritten edict said the implementation was too hasty. Maoliang awaited punishment.

sentences.zh: 上使人宣諭委曲，令繳進手詔，且謂：「卿去雖得美名，置朕何地？

translations.literal: The Emperor sent someone to explain in detail, ordering the handwritten edict returned, and said: "Though you leave with a fine name, where does that leave me?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent someone to explain in detail, ordering the handwritten edict returned, and said, "Though you leave with a fine name, where does that leave me?"

sentences.zh: 」茂良即奉詔。

translations.literal: Maoliang immediately obeyed the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang immediately obeyed the edict.

sentences.zh: 謝廓然賜出身，除殿中侍御史，廓然附曾覿者也。

translations.literal: Xie Kuoran was granted initial appointment and appointed Palace Attendant — Kuoran was one who attached to Zeng Di.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Kuoran was granted initial appointment and appointed palace attendant — Kuoran was one who attached to Zeng Di.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人林光輔繳奏，不書黃，遂補外。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery Lin Guangfu returned the memorial and did not write the yellow copy; he was then sent outside.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director of the Secretariat-Chancellery Lin Guangfu returned the memorial and did not write the yellow copy. He was then sent outside.

sentences.zh: 茂良力求去，上諭曰：「朕極知卿，不敢忘，欲保全卿去，俟議恢復，卿當再來。

translations.literal: Maoliang forcefully begged to leave; the Emperor instructed: "I know you extremely well and dare not forget — I wish to preserve you in leaving; wait until recovery is debated and you should come again."
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang forcefully begged to leave. The Emperor instructed, "I know you extremely well and dare not forget. I wish to preserve you in leaving. Wait until recovery is debated and you should come again."

sentences.zh: 」是日，除職與郡，令內殿奏事，乃手疏恢復六事，上曰：「卿五年不說恢復，何故今日及此？

translations.literal: That day he was given office and a prefecture, ordered to memorialized in the inner hall — he then hand-memorialized six matters on recovery; the Emperor said: "You five years did not speak of recovery — why today reach this?"
translations.idiomatic: That day he was given office and a prefecture, ordered to memorialize in the inner hall. He then hand-memorialized six matters on recovery. The Emperor said, "You five years did not speak of recovery — why today reach this?"

sentences.zh: 」退朝甚怒，曰：「福建子不可信如此！

translations.literal: " After court he was very angry and said: "Fujian men cannot be trusted like this!"
translations.idiomatic: After court he was very angry and said, "Fujian men cannot be trusted like this!"

sentences.zh: 」謝廓然因劾之，乃落職放罷；

translations.literal: Xie Kuoran thereupon impeached him — office was stripped and he was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: Xie Kuoran thereupon impeached him — office was stripped and he was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 尋又論茂良擅權不公，矯傳上旨，輒斷賈光祖等罪，遂責降，安置英州。

translations.literal: soon he again argued Maoliang abused power unfairly, falsely transmitted the imperial intent, and arbitrarily judged Jia Guangzu and others guilty — he was demoted and exiled, settled in Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: soon he again argued Maoliang abused power unfairly, falsely transmitted the imperial intent, and arbitrarily judged Jia Guangzu and others guilty — he was demoted and exiled, settled in Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 父子卒于貶所。

translations.literal: Father and son died in exile.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son died in exile.

sentences.zh: 覿與廓然死後，茂良家投匭訟冤，遂復通奉大夫。

translations.literal: After Di and Kuoran died, Maoliang's family submitted a complaint box seeking redress — he was restored to Grand Master for Appeasing the State.
translations.idiomatic: After Di and Kuoran died, Maoliang's family submitted a complaint box seeking redress. He was restored to grand master for appeasing the state.

sentences.zh: 周必大獨相，進呈復職，上曰：「茂良本無罪。

translations.literal: Zhou Bida alone was grand councilor; presenting restoration of office, the Emperor said: "Maoliang originally had no guilt."
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida alone was grand councilor. Presenting restoration of office, the Emperor said, "Maoliang originally had no guilt."

sentences.zh: 」遂復資政殿學士，諡「莊敏」。

translations.literal: " He was restored Grand Academician of the Hall of Literary Policy; posthumous title "Zhuangmin."
translations.idiomatic: He was restored grand academician of the Hall of Literary Policy. Posthumous title "Zhuangmin."

sentences.zh: 茂良平生不喜言兵，去國之日乃言恢復事，或謂覿密令人訹之云：「若論恢復，必再留。

translations.literal: Maoliang all his life disliked speaking of war; on the day he left the state he spoke of recovery — some say Di secretly had someone threaten him: "If you discuss recovery, you will surely be kept again."
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang all his life disliked speaking of war. On the day he left the state he spoke of recovery — some say Di secretly had someone threaten him, "If you discuss recovery, you will surely be kept again."

sentences.zh: 」茂良信之。

translations.literal: " Maoliang believed it.
translations.idiomatic: Maoliang believed it.

sentences.zh: 廓然論茂良，亦以此為罪。

translations.literal: Kuoran's impeachment of Maoliang also took this as a crime.
translations.idiomatic: Kuoran's impeachment of Maoliang also took this as a crime.

sentences.zh: 茂良沒數年，朱熹從其子得副本讀之，則事雖恢復，而其意乃極論不可輕舉，猶平生素論也，深為之歎息云。

translations.literal: Several years after Maoliang's death, Zhu Xi obtained a copy from his son and read it — though the matter was recovery, its intent extremely argued against light action, still his lifelong plain doctrine — he sighed deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Several years after Maoliang's death, Zhu Xi obtained a copy from his son and read it. Though the matter was recovery, its intent extremely argued against light action — still his lifelong plain doctrine. He sighed deeply.

sentences.zh: 論曰：葛邲在相位雖不久，而能守法度，進人才，其處己也，則以不欺為本。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Ge Bi in the top post though not long was able to preserve laws and institutions and advance talent; in conducting himself he took honesty as root.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Ge Bi in the top post though not long was able to preserve laws and institutions and advance talent. In conducting himself he took honesty as root.

sentences.zh: 錢端禮以戚屬為相，周葵晚雖不附秦檜，而與龔茂良皆主和議。

translations.literal: Qian Duanli as in-law became grand councilor; Zhou Kui though late did not attach to Qin Hui — yet he with Gong Maoliang both favored peace.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Duanli as in-law became grand councilor. Zhou Kui though late did not attach to Qin Hui — yet he with Gong Maoliang both favored peace.

sentences.zh: 若乃魏杞奉使知尊國體，施師點之靖重有守，蕭燧忠實敢言，仕於紹興之間，可謂不幸矣。

translations.literal: As for Wei Qi as envoy knowing how to honor the state's dignity, Shi Shidian's calm principle and steadfastness, Xiao Sui's honest daring in speech — serving in the Shaoxing era, one may say they were unfortunate.
translations.idiomatic: As for Wei Qi as envoy knowing how to honor the state's dignity, Shi Shidian's calm principle and steadfastness, Xiao Sui's honest daring in speech — serving in the Shaoxing era, one may say they were unfortunate.
